   489	def _normalize_elsst(parsed: ElsstVocabulary, source: RegistryInputPin) -> RegistryRelease:
   490	    member_iris = {concept.concept_iri for concept in parsed.concepts}
   491	    labels: dict[str, list[RegistryLabel]] = defaultdict(list)
   492	    dropped = 0
   493	    for row in parsed.labels:
   494	        if row.subject_iri not in member_iris:
   495	            continue
   496	        if not _english(row.value.language_tag):
   497	            dropped += 1
   498	            continue
   499	        labels[row.subject_iri].append(
   500	            RegistryLabel(
   501	                value=row.value.lexical_form.strip(),
   502	                role=row.role,
   503	                source_path=f"{row.subject_iri}::{row.property_iri}",
   504	            )
   505	        )
   506	    notes: dict[str, list[Any]] = defaultdict(list)
   507	    for row in parsed.notes:
   508	        if row.subject_iri in member_iris and _english(row.value.language_tag):
   509	            notes[row.subject_iri].append(row)
   510	    notations: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
   511	    for row in parsed.notations:
   512	        if row.subject_iri in member_iris:
   513	            notations[row.subject_iri].append(row.value.lexical_form)
   514	    metadata: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
   515	    for row in parsed.metadata_literals:
   516	        if row.subject_iri in member_iris and (row.value.language_tag is None or _english(row.value.language_tag)):
   517	            metadata[row.subject_iri].append({"propertyIri": row.property_iri, **_literal_payload(row.value)})
   518	    deprecated = {
   519	        row.subject_iri: row.value.lexical_form.casefold() == "true"
   520	        for row in parsed.deprecated_assertions
   521	        if row.subject_iri in member_iris and row.predicate_iri == ELSST_DEPRECATED
   522	    }
   523	    resources: list[RegistryResource] = []
   524	    for concept in parsed.concepts:
   525	        concept_notes = notes.get(concept.concept_iri, ())
   526	        definitions = [
   527	            row.value.lexical_form
   528	            for row in concept_notes
   529	            if row.property_iri == "http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition"
   530	        ]
   531	        other_notes = [
   532	            row.value.lexical_form
   533	            for row in concept_notes
   534	            if row.property_iri != "http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition"
   535	        ]
   536	        resources.append(
   537	            RegistryResource(
   538	                iri=concept.concept_iri,
   539	                labels=_sorted_labels(labels[concept.concept_iri]),
   540	                native_payload={
   541	                    "publisherConceptIri": concept.concept_iri,
   542	                    "schemeIris": list(concept.scheme_iris),
   543	                    "topConceptOfIris": list(concept.top_concept_of_iris),
   544	                    "metadata": metadata.get(concept.concept_iri, []),
   545	                },
   546	                source_locator=concept.concept_iri,
   547	                source_digest=source.sha256,
   548	                definition=definitions[0] if definitions else None,
   549	                notes=tuple(other_notes + definitions[1:]),
   550	                notations=tuple(notations.get(concept.concept_iri, ())),
   551	                status="deprecated" if deprecated.get(concept.concept_iri, False) else "active",
   552	            )
   553	        )
   554	    return _release(
   555	        key="elsst-r6",
   556	        resource_id="elsst",
   557	        source_module="refspec.registry.elsst",
   558	        scope="publisherRelease",
   559	        issued="2025-09-23",
   560	        source_release_iri=ELSST_R6.release_iri,
   561	        atlas_release_iri="urn:ref:atlas-release:3:elsst:r6",
   562	        scheme_iri="urn:ref:atlas-resource-scheme:elsst",
   563	        source=source,
   564	        resources=resources,
   565	        relations=_direct_relations(parsed.semantic_relations, member_iris),
   566	        dropped_label_count=dropped,
   567	    )
   568

   587	def _normalize_eurovoc(
   588	    parsed: EuroVocVocabulary,
   589	    archive: RegistryInputPin,
   590	    metadata: RegistryInputPin,
   587	def _normalize_eurovoc(
   588	    parsed: EuroVocVocabulary,
   589	    archive: RegistryInputPin,
   590	    metadata: RegistryInputPin,
   591	) -> tuple[RegistryRelease, RegistryRelease]:
   592	    """Split the complete source into its thesaurus and domain schemes."""
   593	
   594	    concept_iris = {concept.concept_iri for concept in parsed.concepts}
   595	    domain_iris = {domain.domain_iri for domain in parsed.domains}
   596	    memberships: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
   597	    for row in parsed.scheme_memberships:
   598	        memberships[row.subject_iri].append(row.object_iri)
   599	    top_concept_of: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
   600	    for row in parsed.top_concept_of_relations:
   601	        top_concept_of[row.subject_iri].append(row.object_iri)
   602	
   603	    labels: dict[str, list[RegistryLabel]] = defaultdict(list)
   604	    dropped_by_kind = {"concept": 0, "domain": 0}
   605	    for row in parsed.labels:
   606	        kind = (
   607	            "concept"
   608	            if row.subject_iri in concept_iris
   609	            else "domain"
   610	            if row.subject_iri in domain_iris
   611	            else None
   612	        )
   613	        if kind is None:
   614	            continue
   615	        if not _english(row.value.language_tag):
   616	            dropped_by_kind[kind] += 1
   617	            continue
   618	        labels[row.subject_iri].append(
   619	            RegistryLabel(
   620	                value=row.value.lexical_form.strip(),
   621	                role=row.role,
   622	                source_path=f"{row.subject_iri}::{row.property_iri}",
   623	            )
   624	        )
   625	
   626	    label_conflict_count = 0
   627	
   628	    def normalized_labels(iri: str) -> tuple[RegistryLabel, ...]:
   629	        nonlocal label_conflict_count
   630	        retained, conflicts = _normalize_skos_label_roles(labels[iri])
   631	        label_conflict_count += len(conflicts)
   632	        return retained
   633	
   634	    common_payload = {
   635	        "attribution": EUROVOC_RELEASE_4_24.attribution,
   636	        "licenseIri": EUROVOC_RELEASE_4_24.license_iri,
   637	        "publisher": EUROVOC_RELEASE_4_24.publisher,
   638	        "releaseVersion": EUROVOC_RELEASE_4_24.version,
   639	    }
   640	    concept_resources = tuple(
   641	        RegistryResource(
   642	            iri=concept.concept_iri,
   643	            labels=normalized_labels(concept.concept_iri),
   644	            native_payload={
   645	                **common_payload,
   646	                "publisherConceptIri": concept.concept_iri,
   647	                "publisherResourceKind": "ThesaurusConcept",
   648	                "schemeIris": sorted(memberships[concept.concept_iri]),
   649	                "topConceptOfIris": sorted(top_concept_of[concept.concept_iri]),
   650	            },
   651	            source_locator=concept.concept_iri,
   652	            source_digest=EUROVOC_RELEASE_4_24.expected_member_sha256,
   653	            notations=(concept.notation,),
   654	            status="active",
   655	        )
   656	        for concept in parsed.concepts
   657	    )
   658	    domain_resources = tuple(
   659	        RegistryResource(
   660	            iri=domain.domain_iri,
   661	            labels=normalized_labels(domain.domain_iri),
   662	            native_payload={
   663	                **common_payload,
   664	                "publisherConceptIri": domain.domain_iri,
   665	                "publisherResourceKind": "Domain",
   666	                "schemeIris": sorted(memberships[domain.domain_iri]),
   667	                "topConceptOfIris": sorted(top_concept_of[domain.domain_iri]),
   668	            },
   669	            source_locator=domain.domain_iri,
   670	            source_digest=EUROVOC_RELEASE_4_24.expected_member_sha256,
   671	            notations=(domain.code,),
   672	            status="active",
   673	        )
   674	        for domain in parsed.domains
   675	    )
   676	    if label_conflict_count:
   677	        raise ValueError(
   678	            "EuroVoc 4.24 contains English labels assigned to multiple SKOS roles"
   679	        )
   680	
   681	    inputs = (archive, metadata)
   682	    release_digest_basis = {
   683	        "archiveDigest": archive.sha256,
   684	        "memberDigest": EUROVOC_RELEASE_4_24.expected_member_sha256,
   685	        "metadataDigest": metadata.sha256,
   686	        "version": EUROVOC_RELEASE_4_24.version,
   687	    }
   688	    concepts = _release(
   689	        key="eurovoc-4.24",
   690	        resource_id="eurovoc",
   691	        source_module="refspec.registry.eurovoc_thesaurus",
   692	        scope="publisherRelease",
   693	        issued=EUROVOC_RELEASE_4_24.issued,
   694	        source_release_iri=(
   695	            "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/dataset/"
   696	            "eurovoc/20260708-0#thesaurus-concepts"
   697	        ),
   698	        atlas_release_iri="urn:ref:atlas-release:3:eurovoc:4.24",
   699	        scheme_iri="urn:ref:atlas-resource-scheme:eurovoc",
   700	        source=archive,
   701	        inputs=inputs,
   702	        source_release_digest=canonical_digest(
   703	            {**release_digest_basis, "memberPartition": "thesaurusConcepts"}
   704	        ),
   705	        resources=concept_resources,
   706	        relations=_direct_relations(parsed.semantic_relations, concept_iris),
   707	        dropped_label_count=dropped_by_kind["concept"],
   708	        metadata={
   709	            "completePublisherRelease": True,
   710	            "licenseIri": EUROVOC_RELEASE_4_24.license_iri,
   711	            "memberPartition": "thesaurusConcepts",
   712	            "publisherConceptCount": len(concept_resources),
   713	            "sourceArchiveDigest": archive.sha256,
   714	            "sourceMemberDigest": EUROVOC_RELEASE_4_24.expected_member_sha256,
   715	            "sourceMetadataDigest": metadata.sha256,
   716	            "thesaurusVersion": parsed.thesaurus_version,
   717	        },
   718	    )
   719	    domains = _release(
   720	        key="eurovoc-domains-4.24",
   721	        resource_id="eurovoc",
   722	        source_module="refspec.registry.eurovoc_thesaurus",
   723	        scope="publisherRelease",
   724	        issued=EUROVOC_RELEASE_4_24.issued,
   725	        source_release_iri=(
   726	            "http://publications.europa.eu/resource/dataset/"
   727	            "eurovoc/20260708-0#domains"
   728	        ),
   729	        atlas_release_iri="urn:ref:atlas-release:3:eurovoc-domains:4.24",
   730	        scheme_iri="urn:ref:atlas-resource-scheme:eurovoc:domains",
   731	        source=archive,
   732	        inputs=inputs,
   733	        source_release_digest=canonical_digest(
   734	            {**release_digest_basis, "memberPartition": "domains"}
   735	        ),
   736	        resources=domain_resources,
   737	        dropped_label_count=dropped_by_kind["domain"],
   738	        metadata={
   739	            "completePublisherRelease": True,
   740	            "licenseIri": EUROVOC_RELEASE_4_24.license_iri,
   741	            "memberPartition": "domains",
   742	            "publisherConceptCount": len(domain_resources),
   743	            "sourceArchiveDigest": archive.sha256,
   744	            "sourceMemberDigest": EUROVOC_RELEASE_4_24.expected_member_sha256,
   745	            "sourceMetadataDigest": metadata.sha256,
   746	            "thesaurusVersion": parsed.thesaurus_version,
   747	        },
   748	    )
   749	    return concepts, domains

   752	def _claim_release_input_pin(
   753	    view: RegistryClaimReleaseView,
   754	    filename: str,
   755	) -> RegistryInputPin:
   756	    """Restore the established Atlas logical pin for one verified raw member."""
   757	
   758	    matching = [
   759	        row
   760	        for row in cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], view.manifest["rawInputs"])
   761	        if Path(cast(str, row["path"])).name == filename
   762	    ]
   763	    if len(matching) != 1:
   764	        raise ValueError(
   765	            f"EuroVoc claim release must contain one raw input named {filename}"
   766	        )
   767	    row = matching[0]
   768	    return RegistryInputPin(
   769	        path=view.root / cast(str, row["path"]),
   770	        logical_path=f"refspec/output/registry-real-data-sources/{filename}",
   771	        sha256=cast(str, row["sha256"]),
   772	        byte_length=cast(int, row["byteLength"]),
   773	        source_iri=cast(str, row["sourceLocator"]),
   774	    )

   777	def _open_eurovoc_4_24_claim_release(
   778	    input_: AtlasRegistryClaimInput,
   779	) -> tuple[RegistryClaimReleaseView, RegistryInputPin, RegistryInputPin]:
   780	    """Open the exact EuroVoc bundle and restore its established input pins."""
   800	    ):
   801	        raise ValueError("EuroVoc claim release raw pins differ from release 4.24")
   802	    manifest_metadata = cast(Mapping[str, Any], view.manifest["metadata"])
   803	    expected_metadata = {
   804	        "attribution": EUROVOC_RELEASE_4_24.attribution,
   805	        "licenseIri": EUROVOC_RELEASE_4_24.license_iri,
   806	        "publisher": EUROVOC_RELEASE_4_24.publisher,
   807	        "version": EUROVOC_RELEASE_4_24.version,
   808	    }
   809	    if any(
   810	        manifest_metadata.get(key) != value
   811	        for key, value in expected_metadata.items()
   812	    ):
   813	        raise ValueError("EuroVoc claim release metadata differs from release 4.24")
   814	    return view, archive, metadata

   848	    )

   867	def _eurovoc_domain_release_from_claims(
   868	    view: RegistryClaimReleaseView,
   869	    archive: RegistryInputPin,
   870	    metadata: RegistryInputPin,
   871	) -> RegistryRelease:
   872	    """Build the EuroVoc domains view from an already verified claim release."""
   873	
   874	    resources = registry_resources_from_claim_release(
   875	        view,
   876	        _eurovoc_claim_resource_rules(
   877	            member_predicate="http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#inScheme",
   878	            member_object_iri="http://eurovoc.europa.eu/domains",
   879	            resource_kind="Domain",
   880	        ),
   881	    )
   882	    source_digests = {resource.source_digest for resource in resources}
   883	    if source_digests != {EUROVOC_RELEASE_4_24.expected_member_sha256}:
   884	        raise ValueError("EuroVoc domain claims do not use the pinned RDF member")
   885	    return _release(

  1050	def _normalize_gemet(parsed: GemetVocabulary, source: RegistryInputPin) -> RegistryRelease:
  1051	    member_iris = {concept.concept_iri for concept in parsed.concepts}
  1052	    labels: dict[str, list[RegistryLabel]] = defaultdict(list)
  1053	    dropped = 0
  1054	    for row in parsed.labels:
  1055	        if row.subject_iri not in member_iris:
  1056	            continue
  1057	        if not _english(row.value.language_tag):
  1058	            dropped += 1
  1059	            continue
  1060	        labels[row.subject_iri].append(
  1061	            RegistryLabel(
  1062	                value=row.value.lexical_form,
  1063	                role=row.role,
  1064	                source_path=f"{row.subject_iri}::{row.property_iri}",
  1065	            )
  1066	        )
  1067	    notes: dict[str, list[Any]] = defaultdict(list)
  1068	    for row in parsed.notes:
  1069	        if row.subject_iri in member_iris and _english(row.value.language_tag):
  1070	            notes[row.subject_iri].append(row)
  1071	    notations: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
  1072	    for row in parsed.notations:
  1073	        if row.subject_iri in member_iris and _english(row.value.language_tag):
  1074	            notations[row.subject_iri].append(row.value.lexical_form)
  1075	    metadata: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
  1076	    for row in parsed.metadata_literals:
  1077	        if row.subject_iri in member_iris and (row.value.language_tag is None or _english(row.value.language_tag)):
  1078	            metadata[row.subject_iri].append({"propertyIri": row.property_iri, **_literal_payload(row.value)})
  1079	
  1080	    resources: list[RegistryResource] = []
  1081	    label_role_conflict_count = 0
  1082	    for concept in parsed.concepts:
  1083	        concept_notes = notes.get(concept.concept_iri, ())
  1084	        definitions = [row.value.lexical_form for row in concept_notes if row.property_iri == GEMET_DEFINITION]
  1085	        other_notes = [row.value.lexical_form for row in concept_notes if row.property_iri != GEMET_DEFINITION]
  1086	        normalized_labels, label_role_conflicts = _normalize_skos_label_roles(
  1087	            labels[concept.concept_iri]
  1088	        )
  1089	        label_role_conflict_count += len(label_role_conflicts)
  1090	        native_payload: dict[str, Any] = {
  1091	            "publisherConceptIri": concept.concept_iri,
  1092	            "schemeIris": list(concept.scheme_iris),
  1093	            "topConceptOfIris": list(concept.top_concept_of_iris),
  1094	            "metadata": metadata.get(concept.concept_iri, []),
  1095	        }
  1096	        if label_role_conflicts:
  1097	            native_payload["labelRoleNormalization"] = {
  1098	                "conflicts": list(label_role_conflicts),
  1099	                "rule": "skos-s13-preferred-alternate-hidden-precedence-v1",
  1100	            }
  1101	        resources.append(
  1102	            RegistryResource(
  1103	                iri=concept.concept_iri,
  1104	                labels=normalized_labels,
  1105	                native_payload=native_payload,
  1106	                source_locator=concept.concept_iri,
  1107	                source_digest=source.sha256,
  1108	                definition=definitions[0] if definitions else None,
  1109	                notes=tuple(other_notes + definitions[1:]),
  1110	                notations=tuple(notations.get(concept.concept_iri, ())),
  1111	            )
  1112	        )
  1113	    return _release(
  1114	        key="gemet-4.2.3",
  1115	        resource_id="gemet",
  1116	        source_module="refspec.registry.gemet_thesaurus",
  1117	        scope="publisherRelease",
  1118	        issued="2021-12-06",
  1119	        source_release_iri="urn:ref:source-release:gemet:4.2.3",
  1120	        atlas_release_iri="urn:ref:atlas-release:3:gemet:4.2.3",
  1121	        scheme_iri="urn:ref:atlas-resource-scheme:gemet",
  1122	        source=source,
  1123	        resources=resources,
  1124	        relations=_direct_relations(parsed.semantic_relations, member_iris),
  1125	        dropped_label_count=dropped,
  1126	        metadata={
  1127	            "labelRoleConflictCount": label_role_conflict_count,
  1128	            "labelRoleConflictRule": (
  1129	                "skos-s13-preferred-alternate-hidden-precedence-v1"
  1130	            ),
  1131	        },
  1132	    )
  1133

  1154	    member_iris = {concept.concept_iri for concept in parsed.concepts}
  1155	    labels: dict[str, list[RegistryLabel]] = defaultdict(list)
  1156	    dropped = 0
  1157	    for row in parsed.labels:
  1158	        if row.subject_iri not in member_iris:
  1159	            continue
  1160	        if not _english(row.value.language_tag, untagged_is_english=True):
  1161	            dropped += 1
  1162	            continue
  1163	        labels[row.subject_iri].append(
  1164	            RegistryLabel(
  1165	                value=row.value.lexical_form,
  1166	                role=row.role,
  1167	                source_path=f"{row.subject_iri}::{row.property_iri}",
  1168	            )
  1169	        )
  1170	    metadata: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
  1171	    for row in parsed.metadata_literals:
  1172	        if row.subject_iri in member_iris and (row.value.language_tag is None or _english(row.value.language_tag)):
  1173	            metadata[row.subject_iri].append({"propertyIri": row.property_iri, **_literal_payload(row.value)})
  1174	    resources = tuple(
  1175	        RegistryResource(
  1176	            iri=concept.concept_iri,
  1177	            labels=_sorted_labels(labels[concept.concept_iri]),
  1178	            native_payload={
  1179	                "publisherConceptIri": concept.concept_iri,
  1180	                "metadata": metadata.get(concept.concept_iri, []),

  1184	            source_digest=source.sha256,
  1185	        )
  1186	        for concept in parsed.concepts

  1188	    direct_rows = (*parsed.semantic_relations, *parsed.use_reference_relations)
  1189	    return _release(
  1190	        key="nasa-thesaurus-skos",

  1196	        atlas_release_iri="urn:ref:atlas-release:3:nasa-thesaurus:skos",
  1197	        scheme_iri="urn:ref:atlas-resource-scheme:nasa-thesaurus",
  1198	        source=source,
  1199	        resources=resources,
  1200	        relations=_direct_relations(
  1201	            direct_rows,
  1202	            member_iris,
  1203	            predicate_map=_NASA_RELATION_PREDICATES,
  1204	        ),
  1205	        dropped_label_count=dropped,
  1206	    )

   647	def _nalt_releases(root: Path) -> tuple[RegistryRelease, ...]:
   648	    fixture_root = "tests/fixtures/nalt_core"
   649	    specs = (
   650	        nalt_core.NALT_CORE_ANIMAL_WELFARE_CAPTURE,
   651	        nalt_core.NALT_CORE_TOP_CONCEPT_CAPTURE,
   652	    )
   653	    pins: list[RegistryInputPin] = []
   654	    captures: list[nalt_core.NaltCoreCapture] = []
   655	    for spec in specs:
   656	        logical_path = f"{fixture_root}/{spec.filename}"
   657	        pin = _pin(
   658	            root,
   659	            logical_path,
   660	            sha256=spec.expected_sha256,
   661	            byte_length=spec.expected_byte_length,
   662	            source_iri=spec.source_url,
   663	        )
   664	        pins.append(pin)
   665	        captures.append(
   666	            nalt_core.parse_nalt_core_file(
   667	                pin.path,
   668	                source_url=spec.source_url,
   669	                concept_iri=spec.concept_iri,
   670	                expected_sha256=spec.expected_sha256,
   671	                expected_byte_length=spec.expected_byte_length,
   672	            )
   673	        )
   674	
   675	    requested = {capture.requested_concept_iri for capture in captures}
   676	    resources: list[RegistryResource] = []
   677	    dropped_labels = 0
   678	    for capture, pin in zip(captures, pins, strict=True):
   679	        vocabulary = capture.vocabulary
   680	        source_path = pin.logical_path
   681	        source_labels = [item for item in vocabulary.labels if item.subject_iri == capture.requested_concept_iri]
   682	        english_labels = [item for item in source_labels if item.value.language_tag in {None, "en"}]
   683	        dropped_labels += len(source_labels) - len(english_labels)
   684	        labels = tuple(_label(item.value.lexical_form, source_path, item.role) for item in english_labels)
   685	        if sum(label.role == "preferred" for label in labels) != 1:
   686	            raise ValueError(f"NALT capture has no single English preferred label: {capture.requested_concept_iri}")
   687	        direct_relations = [
   688	            relation
   689	            for relation in vocabulary.semantic_relations
   690	            if relation.subject_iri == capture.requested_concept_iri
   691	        ]
   692	        resources.append(
   693	            RegistryResource(
   694	                iri=capture.requested_concept_iri,
   695	                labels=labels,
   696	                native_payload=_frozen(
   697	                    {
   698	                        "concept": capture.requested_concept,
   699	                        "directSemanticRelations": direct_relations,
   700	                        "sourcePredicateCounts": vocabulary.predicate_counts,
   701	                        "captureScope": "one requested NALT Core concept",
   702	                    }
   703	                ),
   704	                source_locator=pin.source_iri,
   705	                source_digest=pin.sha256,
   706	            )
   707	        )
   708	
   709	    relation_rows: dict[tuple[str, str, str], RegistryRelation] = {}
   710	    for capture in captures:
   711	        for relation in capture.vocabulary.semantic_relations:
   712	            if relation.subject_iri not in requested or relation.object_iri not in requested:
   713	                continue
   714	            key = (relation.subject_iri, relation.predicate_iri, relation.object_iri)
   715	            relation_rows[key] = RegistryRelation(
   716	                subject=relation.subject_iri,
   717	                predicate=relation.predicate_iri,
   718	                object=relation.object_iri,
   719	                source_payload=_frozen(
   720	                    {
   721	                        "publisherRelation": dataclasses.asdict(relation),
   722	                        "captureScope": "relation whose two endpoints are both emitted",
   723	                    }
   724	                ),
   725	            )
   150	    language: str = "en"
   151	
   152	    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
   153	        if self.role not in LABEL_ROLES:
   154	            raise ValueError(f"unsupported registry label role: {self.role!r}")
   155	        if self.language != "en":
   156	            raise ValueError("Atlas registry labels must be normalized to English")
   157	        if not self.value or self.value != self.value.strip():
   158	            raise ValueError("Atlas registry labels must be non-empty trimmed text")
   159	        if not self.source_path:
   160	            raise ValueError("Atlas registry labels must retain a source path")
   161	
   162	
   163	@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
   164	class RegistryIdentifier:
   165	    """One authority-scoped identifier attached to a normalized resource."""
   166	
   167	    value: str
   168	    scheme_iri: str
   169	    source_path: str
   170	
   171	    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
   172	        if not self.value:
   173	            raise ValueError("Atlas registry identifier values must be non-empty")
   174	        if not self.scheme_iri or ":" not in self.scheme_iri:
   175	            raise ValueError("Atlas registry identifier schemes must be absolute IRIs")
   176	        if not self.source_path:
   177	            raise ValueError("Atlas registry identifiers must retain a source path")

   207	            claim = (label.value, label.role)
   208	            if claim in label_claims:
   209	                raise ValueError(
   210	                    f"registry resource {self.iri} repeats label claim {claim!r}"
   211	                )

   214	            if previous_role != label.role:
   215	                raise ValueError(
   216	                    f"registry resource {self.iri} reuses label value "
   217	                    f"{label.value!r} across roles"
   218	                )
   219	        if not self.source_locator or ":" not in self.source_locator:
   220	            raise ValueError(f"registry resource {self.iri} has no absolute source locator")

  1051	    store a second time: one pass over every quad for the predicate allowlist
  1052	    and to collect the subjects, then one `rdf:type` lookup per subject. At
  1053	    32M quads that is the CPU-bound half of the check's measured 570s
  1054	    (`plans/validation-cost-reset-plan.md`, "Inside-the-phases trace"). The
  1055	    parser already touches every quad, so the same facts ride along for one
  1056	    memoized dict lookup per quad and the check keeps only the per-subject
  1057	    type-set equality pass it exists for.
  1058	
  1059	    Semantics are unchanged, deliberately. Nothing here fails: a bad predicate
  1060	    is *recorded*, and `_check_graph_roles` still raises it, in the same order,
  1061	    with the same code and the same message -- so no failure moves phase and
  1062	    no corpus first issue can move with it. `types` holds every asserted
  1063	    subject, including subjects that carry no `rdf:type` at all, because "has
  1064	    exactly one concrete carrier type" is one of the things being checked.
  1065	    """
  1066	
  1067	    graph_id: URIRef
  1068	    projection_only_predicates: frozenset[URIRef]
  1069	    types: dict[URIRef, tuple[Any, ...]] = dataclass_field(default_factory=dict)
  1070	    verdicts: dict[URIRef, int] = dataclass_field(default_factory=dict)
  1071	    first_violation: tuple[int, URIRef, URIRef] | None = None
  1072	    consumed: bool = False
  1073	
  1074	    def consume_types(self) -> dict[URIRef, tuple[Any, ...]]:
  1075	        """Hand the subject/type map over, once, so the reader can drain it.
  1076	
  1077	        The map is the largest thing the check holds at full scale, so the
  1078	        placement pass frees it entry by entry rather than at the end. Handing
  1079	        it over marks the observation spent: a second `_check_graph_roles` over
  1080	        the same object re-derives from the store instead of reading an
  1081	        emptied map.
  1082	        """
  1083	
  1084	        types, self.types, self.consumed = self.types, {}, True
  1085	        return types
  1086	
  1087	    def _classify(self, predicate: URIRef) -> int:
  1088	        """Rank one predicate the way the placement loop used to, per quad."""
  1089	
  1090	        if predicate == RDF.type:
  1091	            verdict = _PLACEMENT_TYPE
  1092	        elif predicate in self.projection_only_predicates:
  1093	            verdict = _PLACEMENT_PROJECTED
  1094	        elif predicate not in ALLOWED_ASSERTED_PREDICATES:
  1095	            verdict = _PLACEMENT_UNSUPPORTED
  1096	        else:
  1097	            verdict = _PLACEMENT_ALLOWED
  1098	        self.verdicts[predicate] = verdict
  1099	        return verdict
  1100	
  1101	    def observe(self, subject: URIRef, predicate: URIRef, obj: Any) -> None:
  1102	        types = self.types
  1103	        verdict = self.verdicts.get(predicate)
  1104	        if verdict is None:
  1105	            verdict = self._classify(predicate)
  1106	        if verdict == _PLACEMENT_TYPE:
  1107	            types[subject] = (*types.get(subject, ()), obj)
  1108	            return
  1109	        if subject not in types:
  1110	            types[subject] = ()
  1111	        if verdict and self.first_violation is None:
  1112	            self.first_violation = (verdict, subject, predicate)
  1113	
  1114	    @classmethod
  1115	    def from_graph(cls, asserted: Graph) -> _AssertedPlacementObservation:
  2440	            raise ValueError(
  2441	                f"{release.key} scheme is outside its registry source namespace: {scheme}"
  2442	            )
  2443	        if (scheme, RDF.type, ATLAS.ResourceScheme) in descriptors:
  2444	            if (scheme, ATLAS.sourceDescriptor, source_descriptor) not in descriptors:
  2445	                raise ValueError(f"{release.key} scheme differs from its source descriptor")
  2446	            if (scheme, ATLAS.resourceProfile, ATLAS[release.profile]) not in descriptors:
  2447	                raise ValueError(
  2448	                    f"{release.key} profile {release.profile!r} differs from its descriptor"
  2449	                )
  2450	            if (scheme, ATLAS.supportedRing, ATLAS[release.ring]) not in descriptors:
  2451	                raise ValueError(
  2452	                    f"{release.key} ring {release.ring!r} differs from its descriptor"
  2453	                )
  2454	        else:
  2455	            policies = ATLAS_VALIDATE._profile_policies()
  2456	            policy = policies.get(ATLAS[release.profile])
  2457	            if policy is None or release.ring not in policy["applicableSemanticRings"]:
  2458	                raise ValueError(
  2459	                    f"{release.key} child scheme profile/ring is not allowed: "
  2460	                    f"{release.profile}/{release.ring}"
  2461	                )
  2462	        if not any(
  2463	            isinstance(row, Mapping)
  2464	            and row.get("resourceId") == release.resource_id
  2465	            and row.get("sourceModule") == release.source_module
  2466	            and row.get("semanticRing") == release.ring
  2467	            for row in index_rows
  2468	        ):
  2469	            raise ValueError(
  2470	                f"{release.key} source module/ring differs from the Atlas index"
  2471	            )
  2472	
  2473	
  2474	def _node_iri(prefix: str, basis: Any) -> URIRef:
  2475	    digest = _canonical_digest(basis).removeprefix("sha256:")
  2476	    return URIRef(f"urn:ref:{prefix}:{digest}")
  2477	
  2478	
  2479	def _add_policy(graph: Graph, payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> URIRef:
  2480	    _assert_portable_editorial_policy_payload(payload)
  2481	    pending = URIRef("urn:ref:atlas-policy:pending:" + _canonical_digest(payload)[7:])
  2482	    graph.add((pending, RDF.type, ATLAS.EditorialPolicy))
  2483	    graph.add(
  2484	        (
  2485	            pending,
  2486	            ATLAS.policyPayload,
  2487	            Literal(
  2488	                ATLAS_VALIDATE.canonical_json_bytes(
  2489	                    _plain(payload), terminal_lf=False
  2490	                ).decode("utf-8"),
  2491	                datatype=RDF.JSON,
  2492	                normalize=False,
  2493	            ),
  2494	        )
  2495	    )
  2496	    digest = ATLAS_VALIDATE.rdf_node_digest(graph, pending)
  2497	    policy = URIRef("urn:ref:atlas-policy:" + digest.removeprefix("sha256:"))
  2498	    for _, predicate, obj in list(graph.triples((pending, None, None))):
  2499	        graph.remove((pending, predicate, obj))
  2500	        graph.add((policy, predicate, obj))
  2501	    # The digest is the policy's IRI, so it is already published; a triple
  2502	    # restating it would be the node saying its own name back.
  2503	    return policy
  2504

  2506	def _add_source_release(
  2507	    graph: Graph,
  2508	    *,
  2509	    identifier: str,
  2510	    digest: str,
  2511	    issued: str,
  2512	    locator: URIRef,
  2513	) -> URIRef:
  2514	    node = URIRef(identifier)
  2515	    graph.add((node, RDF.type, ATLAS.SourceRelease))
  2516	    graph.add((node, DCTERMS.identifier, Literal(identifier)))
  2517	    graph.add((node, DCTERMS.issued, Literal(issued, datatype=XSD.date)))
  2518	    graph.add((node, ATLAS.sourceDigest, Literal(digest)))
  2519	    graph.add((node, ATLAS.sourceLocator, locator))
  2520	    return node

  2523	def _add_source_record(
  2524	    graph: Graph,
  2525	    *,
  5160	    predicate: URIRef,
  5161	    *,
  5162	    expected_type: type[URIRef | Literal] | None = None,
  5163	) -> Any:
  5164	    values = list(graph.objects(subject, predicate))
  5165	    if len(values) != 1:
  5166	        raise ValueError(f"{subject} does not have exactly one {predicate}")
  5167	    value = values[0]
  5168	    if expected_type is not None and not isinstance(value, expected_type):
  5169	        raise TypeError(f"{subject} {predicate} has the wrong RDF term type")
  5170	    return value

  5173	def _atlas_local_name(value: Any, *, context: str) -> str:
  5174	    iri = str(value)
  5175	    namespace = str(ATLAS)
  5176	    if not iri.startswith(namespace) or len(iri) == len(namespace):
  5177	        raise ValueError(f"{context} is not an Atlas vocabulary term: {iri}")
  5178	    return iri[len(namespace) :]
  5179

  5181	def _rkaf_local_name(value: Any, *, context: str) -> str:
  5182	    """Shorten a Rulespec term for the compact projection.
  5183	
  5184	    The compact record carries local names, so a term Atlas adopted from
  5185	    Rulespec projects the same way -- but it is read out of Rulespec's
  5186	    namespace, which is where it is defined.
  5187	    """
  5188	
  5189	    iri = str(value)
  5190	    namespace = str(RKAF)
  5191	    if not iri.startswith(namespace) or len(iri) == len(namespace):
  5192	        raise ValueError(f"{context} is not a Rulespec vocabulary term: {iri}")
  5193	    return iri[len(namespace) :]

  5196	def _compact_record_role(graph: Graph, subject: URIRef) -> CompactRecordRole:
  5197	    types = set(graph.objects(subject, RDF.type))
  5198	    candidates = {
  5199	        role
  5200	        for role, marker in (
  5201	            (CompactRecordRole.RESOURCE, ATLAS.AtlasResource),
  5202	            (CompactRecordRole.LABEL, SKOSXL.Label),
  5203	            (CompactRecordRole.STATEMENT, ATLAS.RelationAssertion),
  5204	            (CompactRecordRole.EVIDENCE_BINDING, RKAF.EvidenceBinding),
  5205	            (CompactRecordRole.SOURCE_RECORD, ATLAS.SourceRecord),
  5206	            (CompactRecordRole.RELEASE, ATLAS.AtlasRelease),
  5207	            (CompactRecordRole.RELEASE, ATLAS.SourceRelease),
  5208	            (CompactRecordRole.IDENTIFIER, ATLAS.Identifier),
  5209	            (CompactRecordRole.LIFECYCLE_EVENT, RKAF.LifecycleEvent),
  5210	        )
  5211	        if marker in types
  5212	    }
  5213	    if len(candidates) != 1:
  5214	        raise ValueError(
  5215	            f"release-owned subject {subject} does not map to one compact role: "
  5216	            f"{sorted(str(value) for value in types)}"
  5217	        )
  5218	    return candidates.pop()
  5219

  5221	def _compact_record_from_graph(
  5222	    graph: Graph,
  5223	    subject: URIRef,
  5224	    role: CompactRecordRole,
  5225	) -> dict[str, Any]:
  5226	    """Losslessly encode one release-owned RDF subject as a logical record."""
  5227	
  5228	    # Computed, never read: `atlas:contentDigest` is off the wire for every
  5229	    # carrier that does not derive its IRI from it, so the record's comparand
  5230	    # is the digest of the node's own facts rather than a triple restating it.
  5231	    record: dict[str, Any] = {
  5232	        "id": str(subject),
  5233	        "contentDigest": ATLAS_VALIDATE.rdf_node_digest(graph, subject),
  5234	    }
  5235	    if role == CompactRecordRole.RESOURCE:
  5236	        record.update(
  5237	            {
  5238	                "release": str(
  5239	                    _one_graph_object(
  5240	                        graph,
  5241	                        subject,
  5242	                        ATLAS.inRelease,
  5243	                        expected_type=URIRef,
  5244	                    )
  5245	                ),
  5246	                "scheme": str(
  5247	                    _one_graph_object(
  5248	                        graph,
  5249	                        subject,
  5250	                        ATLAS.inScheme,
  5251	                        expected_type=URIRef,
  5252	                    )
  5253	                ),
  5254	                "semanticRing": _atlas_local_name(
  5255	                    _one_graph_object(
  5256	                        graph,
  5257	                        subject,
  5258	                        ATLAS.semanticRing,
  5259	                        expected_type=URIRef,
  5260	                    ),

  1050	def _normalize_gemet(parsed: GemetVocabulary, source: RegistryInputPin) -> RegistryRelease:
  1051	    member_iris = {concept.concept_iri for concept in parsed.concepts}
  1052	    labels: dict[str, list[RegistryLabel]] = defaultdict(list)
  1053	    dropped = 0
  1054	    for row in parsed.labels:
  1055	        if row.subject_iri not in member_iris:
  1056	            continue
  1057	        if not _english(row.value.language_tag):
  1058	            dropped += 1
  1059	            continue
  1060	        labels[row.subject_iri].append(
  1061	            RegistryLabel(
  1062	                value=row.value.lexical_form,
  1063	                role=row.role,
  1064	                source_path=f"{row.subject_iri}::{row.property_iri}",
  1065	            )
  1066	        )
  1067	    notes: dict[str, list[Any]] = defaultdict(list)
  1068	    for row in parsed.notes:
  1069	        if row.subject_iri in member_iris and _english(row.value.language_tag):
  1070	            notes[row.subject_iri].append(row)
  1071	    notations: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
  1072	    for row in parsed.notations:
  1073	        if row.subject_iri in member_iris and _english(row.value.language_tag):
  1074	            notations[row.subject_iri].append(row.value.lexical_form)
  1075	    metadata: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
  1076	    for row in parsed.metadata_literals:
  1077	        if row.subject_iri in member_iris and (row.value.language_tag is None or _english(row.value.language_tag)):
  1078	            metadata[row.subject_iri].append({"propertyIri": row.property_iri, **_literal_payload(row.value)})
  1079	
  1080	    resources: list[RegistryResource] = []
  1081	    label_role_conflict_count = 0
  1082	    for concept in parsed.concepts:
  1083	        concept_notes = notes.get(concept.concept_iri, ())
  1084	        definitions = [row.value.lexical_form for row in concept_notes if row.property_iri == GEMET_DEFINITION]
  1085	        other_notes = [row.value.lexical_form for row in concept_notes if row.property_iri != GEMET_DEFINITION]
  1086	        normalized_labels, label_role_conflicts = _normalize_skos_label_roles(
  1087	            labels[concept.concept_iri]
  1088	        )
  1089	        label_role_conflict_count += len(label_role_conflicts)
  1090	        native_payload: dict[str, Any] = {
  1091	            "publisherConceptIri": concept.concept_iri,
  1092	            "schemeIris": list(concept.scheme_iris),
  1093	            "topConceptOfIris": list(concept.top_concept_of_iris),
  1094	            "metadata": metadata.get(concept.concept_iri, []),
  1095	        }
  1096	        if label_role_conflicts:
  1097	            native_payload["labelRoleNormalization"] = {
  1098	                "conflicts": list(label_role_conflicts),
  1099	                "rule": "skos-s13-preferred-alternate-hidden-precedence-v1",
  1100	            }
  1101	        resources.append(
  1102	            RegistryResource(
  1103	                iri=concept.concept_iri,
  1104	                labels=normalized_labels,
  1105	                native_payload=native_payload,
  1106	                source_locator=concept.concept_iri,
  1107	                source_digest=source.sha256,
  1108	                definition=definitions[0] if definitions else None,
  1109	                notes=tuple(other_notes + definitions[1:]),
  1110	                notations=tuple(notations.get(concept.concept_iri, ())),
  1111	            )
  1112	        )
  1113	    return _release(
  1114	        key="gemet-4.2.3",
  1115	        resource_id="gemet",
  1116	        source_module="refspec.registry.gemet_thesaurus",
  1117	        scope="publisherRelease",
  1118	        issued="2021-12-06",

  1153	def _normalize_nasa(parsed: NasaThesaurusVocabulary, source: RegistryInputPin) -> RegistryRelease:
  1154	    member_iris = {concept.concept_iri for concept in parsed.concepts}
  1155	    labels: dict[str, list[RegistryLabel]] = defaultdict(list)
  1156	    dropped = 0
  1157	    for row in parsed.labels:
  1158	        if row.subject_iri not in member_iris:
  1159	            continue
  1160	        if not _english(row.value.language_tag, untagged_is_english=True):
  1161	            dropped += 1
  1162	            continue
  1163	        labels[row.subject_iri].append(
  1164	            RegistryLabel(
  1165	                value=row.value.lexical_form,
  1166	                role=row.role,
  1167	                source_path=f"{row.subject_iri}::{row.property_iri}",
  1168	            )
  1169	        )
  1170	    metadata: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
  1171	    for row in parsed.metadata_literals:
  1172	        if row.subject_iri in member_iris and (row.value.language_tag is None or _english(row.value.language_tag)):
  1173	            metadata[row.subject_iri].append({"propertyIri": row.property_iri, **_literal_payload(row.value)})
  1174	    resources = tuple(
  1175	        RegistryResource(
  1176	            iri=concept.concept_iri,
  1177	            labels=_sorted_labels(labels[concept.concept_iri]),
  1178	            native_payload={
  1179	                "publisherConceptIri": concept.concept_iri,
  1180	                "metadata": metadata.get(concept.concept_iri, []),
  1181	                "detachedAnnotationsNotJoined": True,
  1182	            },
  1183	            source_locator=concept.concept_iri,
  1184	            source_digest=source.sha256,
  1185	        )
  1186	        for concept in parsed.concepts
  1187	    )
  1188	    direct_rows = (*parsed.semantic_relations, *parsed.use_reference_relations)
  1189	    return _release(
  1190	        key="nasa-thesaurus-skos",
  1191	        resource_id="nasa-thesaurus",

  1688	def _load_json(path: Path, *, require_canonical: bool, expected_digest: str | None = None) -> Any:
  1689	    try:
  1690	        raw = path.read_bytes()
  1691	    except OSError as exc:
  1692	        _fail("distribution.file", f"cannot read {path}: {exc}")
  1693	    if expected_digest is not None and "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != expected_digest:
  1694	        _fail("distribution.digest", f"{path.name} digest differs")
  1695	    try:
  1696	        text = raw.decode("utf-8")
  1697	        value = json.loads(
  1698	            text,
  1699	            object_pairs_hook=_reject_duplicate_keys,
  1700	            parse_float=_reject_float,
  1701	            parse_int=_parse_int,
  1702	            parse_constant=_reject_constant,
  1703	        )
  1704	    except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
  1705	        _fail("json.encoding", f"{path.name} is not UTF-8: {exc}")
  1706	    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
  1707	        _fail("json.syntax", f"{path.name} is not valid JSON: {exc}")
  1708	    _reject_nulls_and_numbers(value)
  1709	    if require_canonical and raw != canonical_json_bytes(value):
  1710	        _fail("json.canonical", f"{path.name} is not canonical REF JSON")
  1711	    return value

  1714	def _schema_registry() -> tuple[dict[str, Mapping[str, Any]], Registry]:
  1715	    schemas: dict[str, Mapping[str, Any]] = {}
   160	
   161	An `atlas:nativePayload` uses the same canonical ordering and number rules but
   162	MAY contain JSON `null` when its normalized source-evidence view contains it.
   163	The payload need not copy the publisher record verbatim: an English-only Atlas
   164	distribution keeps multilingual source content external and pins its exact
   165	locator and digest. Descriptor and policy payloads remain on the stricter REF
   166	profile.
   167	
   168	The uncompressed content of every pack MUST be valid UTF-8 N-Quads with absolute
   169	IRIs, no blank nodes, no default-graph statements, one statement per line,
   170	lexicographically sorted unique lines, LF line endings, and one terminal LF. A
   171	serialized line MUST NOT exceed 16,777,216 bytes. Across the complete pack set,
   172	the same quad MUST NOT appear twice. The only named graphs are the three graph
   173	IRIs declared by the manifest. The projection and derived roles may have zero
   174	statements. Global line sorting across packs is neither required nor meaningful.
   175	
   176	Every scheme, release, normalized resource, identifier, source record,
   177	SKOS-XL label, editorial policy, relation assertion, evidence binding,
   178	lifecycle event, projected relation, and derived relation carries
   179	`atlas:contentDigest`. For these nodes, the digest
   180	preimage is the UTF-8 encoding of every outgoing
   181	predicate-object pair except `atlas:contentDigest`, rendered with the RDF 1.1
   182	N-Triples term representation as `<predicate> <object> .`, sorted by complete
   183	line, joined with LF, and terminated by one LF. The value is
   184	`sha256:<64 lowercase hex>`. This digest detects semantic record drift without
   185	requiring publisher-assigned resource IRIs to be replaced.
   186	
   187	### The canonical line
   188	
   189	The binding supplies one shared term renderer (`tools/rdf_canonical.py`) for
   190	fixture construction, registry-descriptor generation, and validation, and one
   191	byte grammar that accepts exactly what that renderer emits. Emission and
   192	acceptance are the same profile stated twice, and
   193	`tests/test_atlas_v3_canonical_line_grammar.py` is the running check that they
   194	agree.
   195	
   196	A canonical line is four terms and a terminator, separated by one space each
   197	and ending in ` .`:
   198	
   199	- **IRIs** are absolute (`scheme:` followed by at least one character), carry
   200	  no embedded credentials, and contain **no escape sequence at all**. The
   201	  admitted character set is RFC 3987's, minus:
   202	  - `<`, `>`, `"`, `{`, `}`, `|`, `^`, `` ` ``, `\` — the ASCII characters
   203	    RFC 3987 already excludes;
   204	  - `[` and `]` — reserved by RFC 3986/3987 for an IP-literal host
   205	    (`http://[::1]/`) and illegal elsewhere. Atlas mints no IP-literal

  2283	def _validated_registry_index_rows(
  2284	    index: Mapping[str, Any],
  2285	    descriptor_proof: Mapping[str, Any],
  2286	) -> tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]:
  2287	    actual_index_digest = _registry_index_content_digest(index)
  2288	    if index.get("indexDigest") != actual_index_digest:
  2289	        raise ValueError("Atlas registry index content digest differs")
  2290	    expected_index_id = (
  2291	        "urn:ref:atlas-index:" + actual_index_digest.removeprefix("sha256:")
  2292	    )
  2293	    if index.get("indexId") != expected_index_id:
  2294	        raise ValueError("Atlas registry index identity differs")
  2295	
  2296	    artifact = descriptor_proof.get("artifact")
  2297	    proof_inputs = descriptor_proof.get("inputs")
  2298	    if not isinstance(artifact, Mapping) or not isinstance(proof_inputs, Mapping):
  2299	        raise TypeError("Atlas registry descriptor proof is incomplete")
  2300	    if artifact.get("sha256") != REGISTRY_DESCRIPTORS_EXPECTED_DIGEST:
  2301	        raise ValueError("Atlas registry descriptor proof pins a different dataset")
  2302	    if proof_inputs.get("atlasIndexDigest") != actual_index_digest:
  2303	        raise ValueError("Atlas registry index differs from the descriptor proof")
  2304	
  2305	    rows = index.get("rows")
  2306	    if not isinstance(rows, list):
  2307	        raise TypeError("Atlas registry index has no rows")
  2308	    if any(not isinstance(row, Mapping) for row in rows):
  2309	        raise TypeError("Atlas registry index contains a non-object row")
  2310	    return tuple(rows)

  2334	def _validate_registry_mapping_release_policy(
  2335	    release: RegistryMappingRelease,
  2336	    *,
  2337	    descriptors: Graph,
  2338	    index_rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
  2339	) -> None:
  2340	    """Reconcile one mapping release with its mapping-only registry policy."""
  2341	
  2342	    source_descriptor = _registry_source_descriptor_iri(release.resource_id)
  2343	    if (source_descriptor, RDF.type, ATLAS.RegistrySource) not in descriptors:
  2344	        raise ValueError(
  2345	            f"{release.key} names unknown registry source {release.resource_id!r}"
  2346	        )
  2347	
  2348	    dispositions = list(
  2349	        descriptors.objects(source_descriptor, ATLAS.memberDisposition)
  2350	    )
  2351	    if dispositions != [Literal("mappingAssertionsOnly")]:
  2352	        raise ValueError(
  2353	            f"{release.key} registry source {release.resource_id!r} is not "
  2354	            "mappingAssertionsOnly"
  2355	        )
  2356	
  2357	    scheme = _registry_primary_scheme_iri(release.resource_id)
  2358	    if (scheme, RDF.type, ATLAS.ResourceScheme) in descriptors:
  2359	        raise ValueError(
  2360	            f"{release.key} mapping-only registry source unexpectedly has a "
  2361	            "ResourceScheme"
  2362	        )
  2363	
  2364	    payloads = list(descriptors.objects(source_descriptor, ATLAS.descriptorPayload))
  2365	    if len(payloads) != 1 or not isinstance(payloads[0], Literal):
  2366	        raise ValueError(f"{release.key} registry source has no unique descriptor payload")
  2367	    try:
  2368	        descriptor_payload = json.loads(str(payloads[0]))
  2369	    except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
  2370	        raise ValueError(
  2371	            f"{release.key} registry source descriptor payload is not JSON"
  2372	        ) from error
  2373	    if not isinstance(descriptor_payload, Mapping):
  2374	        raise TypeError(
  2375	            f"{release.key} registry source descriptor payload is not an object"
  2376	        )
  2377	    if descriptor_payload.get("resourceId") != release.resource_id:
  2378	        raise ValueError(f"{release.key} registry source descriptor identity differs")
  2379	    if descriptor_payload.get("resourceKind") != "mappingReference":
  2380	        raise ValueError(
  2381	            f"{release.key} registry source is not a mappingReference"
  2382	        )
  2383	
  2384	    resource_rows = [
  2385	        row for row in index_rows if row.get("resourceId") == release.resource_id
  2386	    ]
  2387	    if not resource_rows:
  2388	        raise ValueError(
  2389	            f"{release.key} registry source is absent from the Atlas index"
  2390	        )
  2391	    matching_rows = [
  2392	        row
  2393	        for row in resource_rows
  2394	        if row.get("sourceModule") == release.source_module
  2395	        and row.get("semanticRing") == release.ring
  2396	    ]
  2397	    if len(matching_rows) != 1:
  2398	        raise ValueError(
  2399	            f"{release.key} registry source module/ring differs from the Atlas index"
  2400	        )
  2401	    intended_uses = matching_rows[0].get("intendedUses")
  2402	    if not isinstance(intended_uses, list) or "mappingReference" not in intended_uses:
  2403	        raise ValueError(
  2404	            f"{release.key} Atlas index row is not a mappingReference"
  2405	        )

  2411	    """Require every mapping release to pass registry admission policy."""
  2412	
  2413	    descriptors = _registry_asserted_graph()

  3369	
  3370	    This is deliberately narrower than the independent RDF validator. The
  3371	    fixed constructors cover carrier shape and datatype rules; this pass proves

    92	_LABEL_ROLE_ORDER = {"preferred": 0, "alternate": 1, "hidden": 2}

    94	
    95	def _compatibility_labels(
    96	    subject: str,
    97	    claims: Sequence[RegistryClaim],
    98	    rules: RegistryClaimResourceRules,
    99	) -> tuple[RegistryLabel, ...]:
   100	    labels = sorted(
   101	        (
   102	            RegistryLabel(
   103	                value=(
   104	                    cast(str, claim.lexical_value).strip()
   105	                    if rules.strip_label_whitespace
   106	                    else cast(str, claim.lexical_value)
   107	                ),
   108	                role=rules.label_roles[claim.predicate],
   109	                source_path=f"{subject}::{claim.predicate}",
   110	            )
   111	            for claim in claims
   112	            if claim.predicate in rules.label_roles
   113	            and claim.object_kind == "literal"
   114	            and claim.language == "en"
   115	        ),
   116	        key=lambda label: (
   117	            _LABEL_ROLE_ORDER[label.role],
   118	            label.value.casefold(),
   119	            label.value,
   120	            label.source_path,
   121	        ),
   122	    )
   123	    retained: list[RegistryLabel] = []
   124	    retained_by_value: dict[str, RegistryLabel] = {}
   125	    for label in labels:
   126	        previous = retained_by_value.get(label.value)
   127	        if previous is None:
   128	            retained_by_value[label.value] = label
   129	            retained.append(label)
   130	        elif previous.role == label.role:
   131	            raise AtlasRegistryClaimError(
   132	                f"claim resource {subject} repeats {label.role} label {label.value!r}"
   133	            )
   134	    if not retained:
   135	        raise AtlasRegistryClaimError(
   136	            f"claim resource {subject} has no selected English label"
   137	        )
   138	    return tuple(retained)
   139	
   140	
   141	def registry_resources_from_claim_release(
   142	    view: RegistryClaimReleaseView,
   143	    rules: RegistryClaimResourceRules,
   144	) -> tuple[RegistryResource, ...]:
   145	    """Build normalized resources from exact claims using declarative rules."""
   146	
   147	    claims_by_subject: dict[str, list[RegistryClaim]] = defaultdict(list)
   148	    membership_claims: dict[str, list[RegistryClaim]] = defaultdict(list)
   149	    for claim in view.claims:
   150	        claims_by_subject[claim.subject].append(claim)
   151	        if (
   152	            claim.predicate == rules.member_predicate
   153	            and claim.object_kind == "iri"
   154	            and claim.object_iri == rules.member_object_iri
   155	        ):
   156	            membership_claims[claim.subject].append(claim)
   157	    excluded_subjects = {
   158	        claim.subject
   159	        for claim in view.claims
   160	        if claim.object_kind == "iri"
   161	        and (claim.predicate, cast(str, claim.object_iri))
   162	        in rules.excluded_member_claims
   163	    }
   164	    for subject in excluded_subjects:
   165	        membership_claims.pop(subject, None)
   166	    if not membership_claims:
   167	        raise AtlasRegistryClaimError(
   168	            "claim resource rules selected no release members"
   169	        )
   170	
   171	    resources: list[RegistryResource] = []
   172	    for subject in sorted(membership_claims):
   173	        subject_claims = claims_by_subject[subject]
   174	        source_digests = {
   175	            claim.source_digest for claim in membership_claims[subject]
   176	        }
   177	        if len(source_digests) != 1:
   178	            raise AtlasRegistryClaimError(
   179	                f"claim resource {subject} membership evidence differs"
   180	            )
   181	        notations = tuple(
   182	            sorted(
   183	                {
   184	                    cast(str, claim.lexical_value)
   185	                    for claim in subject_claims
   186	                    if claim.predicate in rules.notation_predicates
   187	                    and claim.object_kind == "literal"
   188	                }
   189	            )
   190	        )
   191	        if rules.notation_predicates and not notations:
   192	            raise AtlasRegistryClaimError(
   193	                f"claim resource {subject} has no selected notation"
   194	            )
   195	        native_payload = {
   196	            **rules.common_native_payload,
   197	            "publisherConceptIri": subject,
   198	            "publisherResourceKind": rules.resource_kind,
   199	        }
   200	        for payload_key, predicate in sorted(rules.native_iri_predicates.items()):
   201	            native_payload[payload_key] = sorted(
   202	                {
   203	                    cast(str, claim.object_iri)
   204	                    for claim in subject_claims
   205	                    if claim.predicate == predicate
   206	                    and claim.object_kind == "iri"
   207	                }
   208	            )
   209	        resources.append(
   210	            RegistryResource(
   211	                iri=subject,
   212	                labels=_compatibility_labels(subject, subject_claims, rules),
   213	                native_payload=native_payload,
   214	                source_locator=subject,
   215	                source_digest=next(iter(source_digests)),
   216	                notations=notations,
   217	                status="active",
   218	            )
   219	        )
   220	    return tuple(resources)
   221	
   222	
   223	def registry_relations_from_claim_release(
   224	    view: RegistryClaimReleaseView,
   225	    *,
   226	    member_iris: Collection[str],
   227	    predicate_map: Mapping[str, str],
   228	) -> tuple[RegistryRelation, ...]:
   229	    """Retain direct IRI relations whose endpoints are selected members."""
   230	
   231	    members = frozenset(member_iris)
   232	    relations: list[RegistryRelation] = []
   233	    seen: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
   234	    for claim in view.claims:
   235	        if (
   236	            claim.object_kind != "iri"
   237	            or claim.predicate not in predicate_map
   238	            or claim.subject not in members
   239	            or claim.object_iri not in members
   240	        ):
   241	            continue
   242	        publisher_predicate = claim.predicate
   243	        normalized_predicate = predicate_map[publisher_predicate]
   244	        key = (
   245	            claim.subject,
   246	            normalized_predicate,
   247	            cast(str, claim.object_iri),
   248	        )
   249	        if key in seen:
   250	            continue
   251	        seen.add(key)
   252	        relations.append(
   253	            RegistryRelation(
   254	                subject=key[0],
   255	                predicate=key[1],
   256	                object=key[2],
   257	                source_payload={
   258	                    "normalizedPredicateIri": normalized_predicate,
   259	                    "objectIri": key[2],
   260	                    "predicateIri": publisher_predicate,
   261	                    "subjectIri": key[0],
   262	                },
   263	            )
   264	        )
   265	    return tuple(
   266	        sorted(
   267	            relations,
   268	            key=lambda relation: (
   269	                relation.subject,
   270	                relation.predicate,
   271	                relation.object,
   272	            ),
   273	        )
   274	    )

   277	def _record_key(claim: RegistryClaim) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
   278	    return (claim.source_record_id, claim.source_locator, claim.source_digest)

   281	def _group_claims(
   282	    claims: Sequence[RegistryClaim],
   283	) -> dict[tuple[str, str, str], list[RegistryClaim]]:
   284	    grouped: dict[tuple[str, str, str], list[RegistryClaim]] = defaultdict(list)
   285	    for claim in claims:
   286	        grouped[_record_key(claim)].append(claim)
   287	    return grouped

   300	        "schemaVersion": ATLAS_CLAIM_RECORD_VERSION,

    86	def _safe_member_path(directory: Path, relative: object) -> Path:
    87	    if not isinstance(relative, str):
    88	        raise AtlasParquetSearchViewError("compact view member path must be text")
    89	    parsed = PurePosixPath(relative)
    90	    if parsed.is_absolute() or not parsed.parts or any(part in {"", ".", ".."} for part in parsed.parts):
    91	        raise AtlasParquetSearchViewError(f"compact view member path is unsafe: {relative!r}")
    92	    return directory.joinpath(*parsed.parts)

    95	def _suffix(value: str | None, prefix_name: str) -> bytes | None:
    96	    if value is None:
    97	        return None
    98	    prefix = _PREFIXES[prefix_name]
    99	    if not value.startswith(prefix):
   100	        raise AtlasParquetSearchViewError(f"{prefix_name} identifier has an unsupported prefix: {value}")
   101	    suffix = value.removeprefix(prefix)
   102	    if len(suffix) != 64:
   103	        raise AtlasParquetSearchViewError(f"{prefix_name} identifier has an unsupported digest suffix")
   104	    try:
   105	        return bytes.fromhex(suffix)
   106	    except ValueError as error:
   107	        raise AtlasParquetSearchViewError(f"{prefix_name} identifier has a non-hex digest suffix") from error

   239	def _transform(role: CompactRecordRole, row: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
   240	    if role is CompactRecordRole.RESOURCE:
   241	        return {key: value for key, value in row.items() if key != "content_digest"}
   242	    if role is CompactRecordRole.LABEL:
   243	        if not row.get("id"):
   244	            raise AtlasParquetSearchViewError(_MISSING_LABEL_ID)
   245	        return {key: value for key, value in row.items() if key != "content_digest"}
   246	    if role is CompactRecordRole.STATEMENT:
   247	        if _suffix(row["id"], "assertion") != row["assertion_identity_digest"]:
   248	            raise AtlasParquetSearchViewError("statement identifier differs from assertionIdentityDigest")
   249	        return {key: value for key, value in row.items() if key not in {"assertion_identity_digest", "content_digest"}}
   250	    if role is CompactRecordRole.EVIDENCE_BINDING:
   251	        evidence_id = _suffix(row["id"], "evidence")
   252	        if evidence_id != row["content_digest"]:
   253	            raise AtlasParquetSearchViewError("evidence identifier differs from contentDigest")
   254	        return {
   255	            "evidence_id": evidence_id,
   256	            "statement": row["statement"],
   257	            "source_record": row["source_record"],
   258	            "evidence_source_digest": row["evidence_source_digest"],
   259	            "attestor": row["attestor"],
   260	            "evidence_role": row["evidence_role"],
   261	            "decision": row["decision"],
   262	            "attested_at": row["attested_at"],
   263	        }
   264	    if role is CompactRecordRole.SOURCE_RECORD:
   265	        return {
   266	            "id": row["id"],
   267	            "source_release": row["source_release"],
   268	            "source_digest": row["source_digest"],
   269	            "source_locator": row["source_locator"],
   270	            "represents_resource": row["represents_resource"],
   271	        }
   272	    if role is CompactRecordRole.RELEASE:
   273	        return {key: value for key, value in row.items() if key != "content_digest"}
   274	    if role is CompactRecordRole.IDENTIFIER:
   275	        return {key: value for key, value in row.items() if key != "content_digest"}
   276	    if role is CompactRecordRole.LIFECYCLE_EVENT:
   277	        return {key: value for key, value in row.items() if key != "content_digest"}
   278	    raise AssertionError(role)
   279	
   280	
   281	def _write_role(source: Path, target: Path, role: CompactRecordRole) -> int:
   282	    parquet = pq.ParquetFile(source)
   283	    schema = _SCHEMAS[role]
   284	    writer = pq.ParquetWriter(
   285	        target,
   286	        schema,
   287	        compression="zstd",
   288	        compression_level=COMPRESSION_LEVEL,
   289	        use_dictionary=_DICTIONARIES[role],
   290	        write_statistics=True,
   291	        version="2.6",
   292	        data_page_version="2.0",
   293	    )
   294	    count = 0
   295	    try:
   296	        for batch in parquet.iter_batches(batch_size=ROW_GROUP_SIZE):
   297	            rows = [_transform(role, row) for row in batch.to_pylist()]
   298	            writer.write_table(pa.Table.from_pylist(rows, schema=schema), row_group_size=ROW_GROUP_SIZE)
   299	            count += len(rows)
   300	        if count == 0:
   301	            writer.write_table(schema.empty_table())
   302	    finally:
   303	        writer.close()
   304	    return count

   307	def build_atlas_parquet_search_view(
   308	    full_view: Path,
   309	    output: Path,
   310	    *,
   311	    expected_manifest_digest: str,
   312	) -> dict[str, Any]:
   313	    """Build one immutable compact search view from a verified full view."""
   314	
   315	    if output.is_symlink() or output.exists():
   316	        raise AtlasParquetSearchViewError(f"refusing to replace existing output: {output}")
   317	    full_manifest = verify_atlas_parquet_view(
   318	        full_view,
   319	        expected_manifest_digest=expected_manifest_digest,
   320	    )
   321	    by_role = {CompactRecordRole(member["role"]): member for member in full_manifest["members"]}
   322	    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   323	    temporary = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f".{output.name}.", dir=output.parent))
   324	    try:
   325	        table_root = temporary / "tables"
   326	        table_root.mkdir()
   327	        members = []
   328	        counts = {}
   329	        for role in CompactRecordRole:
   330	            source = full_view / by_role[role]["path"]
   331	            relative = f"tables/{by_role[role]['path'].split('/')[-1]}"
   332	            target = temporary / relative
   333	            row_count = _write_role(source, target, role)
   334	            counts[role.value] = row_count
   335	            if row_count != by_role[role]["rowCount"]:
   336	                raise AtlasParquetSearchViewError(f"{role.value} row count differs from the full view")
   337	            stored_schema = pq.ParquetFile(target).schema_arrow
   338	            members.append(
   339	                {
   340	                    "byteLength": target.stat().st_size,
    55	        return None
    56	    if not isinstance(value, str) or _DIGEST.fullmatch(value) is None:
    57	        raise AtlasParquetTableError(f"{label} must be a lowercase SHA-256 digest")
    58	    return bytes.fromhex(value.removeprefix("sha256:"))

    61	def _binary_digest_field(name: str, *, nullable: bool = True) -> pa.Field:
    62	    return pa.field(name, pa.binary(32), nullable=nullable)

    64	
    65	# Low-cardinality string columns are dictionary-encoded on disk by the writer's
    66	# `use_dictionary=True`, so the four warrant axes cost almost nothing: measured
    67	# on the 560k-row evidence-binding table the five added columns are +99 KB,
    68	# +0.12% of the view.
    69	TABLE_SCHEMAS: Mapping[CompactRecordRole, pa.Schema] = {
    70	    CompactRecordRole.RESOURCE: pa.schema(
    71	        [

    86	def _safe_member_path(directory: Path, relative: object) -> Path:
    87	    if not isinstance(relative, str):
    88	        raise AtlasParquetSearchViewError("compact view member path must be text")
    89	    parsed = PurePosixPath(relative)
    90	    if parsed.is_absolute() or not parsed.parts or any(part in {"", ".", ".."} for part in parsed.parts):
    91	        raise AtlasParquetSearchViewError(f"compact view member path is unsafe: {relative!r}")
    92	    return directory.joinpath(*parsed.parts)

    95	def _suffix(value: str | None, prefix_name: str) -> bytes | None:
    96	    if value is None:
    97	        return None
    98	    prefix = _PREFIXES[prefix_name]
    99	    if not value.startswith(prefix):
   100	        raise AtlasParquetSearchViewError(f"{prefix_name} identifier has an unsupported prefix: {value}")
   101	    suffix = value.removeprefix(prefix)
   102	    if len(suffix) != 64:
   103	        raise AtlasParquetSearchViewError(f"{prefix_name} identifier has an unsupported digest suffix")
   104	    try:
   105	        return bytes.fromhex(suffix)
   106	    except ValueError as error:
   107	        raise AtlasParquetSearchViewError(f"{prefix_name} identifier has a non-hex digest suffix") from error

    82	This command is a fast development gate, not the Atlas 3 release verdict. Its
    83	JSON result lists the remaining release-only checks: closed JSON schemas and
    84	binding pins; producer and acceptance receipts; normative SHACL; RDF lexical,
    85	graph-role, dependency, and node-digest rules; assertion policy, identity, and
    86	lifecycle semantics; projection and derived replay; transitive SKOS conflict
    87	analysis; source-accounting reconciliation; construction record ownership; and
    88	reasoning isolation. Run the independent Atlas validator before calling a
    89	distribution conformant.
    90	
    91	The retired exhaustive compact-to-RDF parity implementation remains available
    92	through the [dated archive note](../research/archive/atlas-3.0-exhaustive-compact-parity-2026-08-08.md).
    93	The active release validator recomputes every release's logical record counts
    94	from the asserted graph; the builder proves full record-identity equality
    95	between the served tables and the graph, both directions, and compares a
    96	bounded deterministic sample of whole rows against the RDF.
    97	
    98	## Compact search profile
    99	
   100	The separately named compact search view retains compressible native text
   101	references and removes reconstructable row-integrity fields. It retains labels,
   102	graph facts, source digests and locators, review decisions, and methods needed
   103	for search explanations. It omits source-native payload bodies and redundant
   104	digests or identifiers whose values are either reconstructed from a retained
   105	identifier or used only to authenticate the pinned full view. Those omitted
   106	values remain in the pinned full view and canonical RDF.
   107	
   108	Search view 1.1 carries the canonical `Label.id` in the Label table's `id`
   109	column, copied from the pinned full view (REF-025). The manifest states
   110	`schemaVersion: 1.1`, `Label.id` is absent from `status.omittedFields`, and
   111	verification refuses a Label member without that column and refuses a manifest
   112	naming another schema version.
   113	
   114	```sh
   115	uv run refspec-build-atlas-search-view \
   116	  --full-view output/atlas-3.0-parquet-view-2026-08-10 \
   117	  --expected-manifest-sha256 cd712aacc0308594e6cad77be327b482779a3fb4cc93dacd7d0c6bb04d1d5207 \
   118	  --output output/atlas-3.0-parquet-search-view-2026-08-11
   119	```

   122	984,114 of them labels, in 224,874,647 bytes across nine files (about 214 MiB).
   123	Its manifest SHA-256 is
   124	`cf645ad8316875b43735561ec2910cf42fd05cf90961dcde2c59c0fdce59759d` and its view
   125	identifier is
   126	`urn:ref:atlas-parquet-search-view:6e2489f0124ffa7e0c1f508452a449057e05de376b4e02b88778581d59786446`.
   127	The label identifier costs 30,887,361 bytes on this data: `tables/labels.parquet`
   128	is 74,779,216 bytes against 43,891,855 in the 1.0 view built from the same full
   129	view, and the members total 224,869,901 bytes against 193,982,540.
