+def _parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--source-root", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--distribution", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    return parser.parse_args()
+
+
+def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _load_rdf_canonical() -> Any:
+    path = Path("bindings/atlas/3.1/tools/rdf_canonical.py").resolve()
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("fidelity_rdf_canonical", path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"cannot import canonical RDF renderer from {path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def _construction_units(distribution: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], str]:
+    path = distribution / audit.CONSTRUCTION_SUMMARY
+    payload = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
+    releases = payload.get("releases")
+    if not isinstance(releases, list):
+        raise ValueError(f"{path}: releases must be an array")
+    units: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    for release in releases:
+        if not isinstance(release, dict) or not isinstance(release.get("key"), str):
+            raise ValueError(f"{path}: malformed release row")
+        units[release["key"]] = release
+    return units, _sha256(path)
+
+
+def _pack_paths(spec: audit.SourceSpec, units: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    paths: list[str] = []
+    for key in spec.release_keys:
+        unit = units.get(key)
+        if unit is None:
+            raise ValueError(f"distribution omits construction unit {key!r}")
+        packs = unit.get("rdfPacks")
+        if not isinstance(packs, list):
+            raise ValueError(f"construction unit {key!r} has malformed rdfPacks")
+        for pack in packs:
+            if not isinstance(pack, dict) or not isinstance(pack.get("path"), str):
+                raise ValueError(f"construction unit {key!r} has malformed pack row")
+            paths.append(pack["path"].removeprefix("packs/"))
+    return tuple(paths)
+
+
+def _source_claim_subjects(view: audit.PublisherView) -> frozenset[str]:
+    schemes = {
+        *view.schemes,
+        *(scheme for _, scheme in view.memberships),
+        *(scheme for _, scheme in view.top_concept_of),
+        *(scheme for scheme, _ in view.has_top_concept),
+    }
+    return frozenset(
+        {
+            *view.concepts,
+            *schemes,
+            *view.resource_annotation_target_claim_counts,
+            *(subject for subject, _, _ in view.relations),
+            *(obj for _, _, obj in view.relations),
+        }
+    )
+
+
+def _literal_key(value: audit.LiteralValue) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
+    return (value.value, value.language or "", value.datatype or "")
+
+
+def _publisher_predicate_claims(
+    view: audit.PublisherView,
+) -> tuple[
+    dict[str, set[tuple[str, audit.LiteralValue]]],
+    dict[str, set[tuple[str, str]]],
+]:
+    direct: dict[str, set[tuple[str, audit.LiteralValue]]] = {
+        name: set() for name in PREDICATES
+    }
+    resource: dict[str, set[tuple[str, str]]] = {name: set() for name in PREDICATES}
+    names_by_iri = {iri: name for name, iri in PREDICATES.items()}
+    for subject, predicate, value in view.literal_claims:
+        name = names_by_iri.get(predicate)
+        if name is not None:
+            direct[name].add((subject, value))
+    for subject, predicate, target in view.iri_claims:
+        name = names_by_iri.get(predicate)
+        if name is not None:
+            resource[name].add((subject, target))
+    return direct, resource
+
+
+def _atlas_values(
+    atlas: audit.AtlasView, predicate: str
+) -> dict[str, frozenset[audit.LiteralValue]]:
+    return atlas.definitions if predicate == audit.ATLAS_DEFINITION else atlas.notes
+
+
+def _claim_accounting(
+    direct: dict[str, set[tuple[str, audit.LiteralValue]]],
+    resource: dict[str, set[tuple[str, str]]],
+    atlas: audit.AtlasView,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, int]], int]:
+    rows: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
+    omitted_total = 0
+    for name in PREDICATES:
+        target = _atlas_values(atlas, WIRE_PREDICATE[name])
+        carried = sum(value in target.get(subject, ()) for subject, value in direct[name])
+        literal_count = len(direct[name])
+        iri_count = len(resource[name])
+        publisher_count = literal_count + iri_count
+        omitted = publisher_count - carried
+        rows[name] = {
+            "publisherClaimCount": publisher_count,
+            "publisherLiteralClaimCount": literal_count,
+            "publisherIriClaimCount": iri_count,
+            "atlasExactLiteralCarryCount": carried,
+            "omittedClaimCount": omitted,
+        }
+        omitted_total += omitted
+    return rows, omitted_total
+
+
+def _english(value: audit.LiteralValue) -> bool:
+    return value.language is not None and value.language.casefold() == "en"
+
+
+def _resolved_english_values(
+    view: audit.PublisherView,
+    target: str,
+) -> frozenset[audit.LiteralValue]:
+    return frozenset(
+        value
+        for subject, predicate, value in view.literal_claims
+        if subject == target and predicate == RDF_VALUE and _english(value)
+    )
+
+
+def _expected_english_definition_scope_wire(
+    view: audit.PublisherView,
+    direct: dict[str, set[tuple[str, audit.LiteralValue]]],
+    resource: dict[str, set[tuple[str, str]]],
+) -> tuple[
+    set[tuple[str, str, audit.LiteralValue]],
+    dict[str, int],
+]:
+    definitions: dict[str, set[audit.LiteralValue]] = defaultdict(set)
+    scope_notes: dict[str, set[audit.LiteralValue]] = defaultdict(set)
+    direct_claims = 0
+    direct_claims_by_predicate = {
+        "skos:definition": 0,
+        "skos:scopeNote": 0,
+    }
+    iri_claims = 0
+    resolved_iri_claims = 0
+    empty_english_text_claims = 0
+
+    for subject, value in direct["skos:definition"]:
+        if _english(value):
+            if not value.value:
+                empty_english_text_claims += 1
+                continue
+            definitions[subject].add(value)
+            direct_claims += 1
+            direct_claims_by_predicate["skos:definition"] += 1
+    for subject, value in direct["skos:scopeNote"]:
+        if _english(value):
+            if not value.value:
+                empty_english_text_claims += 1
+                continue
+            scope_notes[subject].add(value)
+            direct_claims += 1
+            direct_claims_by_predicate["skos:scopeNote"] += 1
+
+    for name, target_rows in (
+        ("skos:definition", definitions),
+        ("skos:scopeNote", scope_notes),
+    ):
+        for subject, target in resource[name]:
+            iri_claims += 1
+            values = frozenset(
+                value for value in _resolved_english_values(view, target) if value.value
+            )
+            if values:
+                resolved_iri_claims += 1
+                target_rows[subject].update(values)
+
+    expected: set[tuple[str, str, audit.LiteralValue]] = set()
+    multi_definition_subject_count = 0
+    for subject, values in definitions.items():
+        ordered = sorted(values, key=_literal_key)
+        if len(ordered) > 1:
+            multi_definition_subject_count += 1
+        expected.add((subject, audit.ATLAS_DEFINITION, ordered[0]))
+        expected.update((subject, audit.ATLAS_NOTE, value) for value in ordered[1:])
+    for subject, values in scope_notes.items():
+        expected.update((subject, audit.ATLAS_NOTE, value) for value in values)
+
+    return expected, {
+        "eligibleDirectLiteralClaimCount": direct_claims,
+        "eligibleDirectLiteralClaimsByPredicate": direct_claims_by_predicate,
+        "eligibleIriClaimCount": iri_claims,
+        "resolvedIriClaimCount": resolved_iri_claims,
+        "unresolvedIriClaimCount": iri_claims - resolved_iri_claims,
+        "emptyEnglishTextClaimCount": empty_english_text_claims,
+        "multiDefinitionSubjectCount": multi_definition_subject_count,
+    }
+
+
+def _current_wire_claims(atlas: audit.AtlasView) -> set[tuple[str, str, audit.LiteralValue]]:
+    rows = {
+        (subject, audit.ATLAS_DEFINITION, value)
+        for subject, values in atlas.definitions.items()
+        for value in values
+    }
+    rows.update(
+        (subject, audit.ATLAS_NOTE, value)
+        for subject, values in atlas.notes.items()
+        for value in values
+    )
+    return rows
+
+
+def _nquads_payload(
+    rows: set[tuple[str, str, audit.LiteralValue]], rdf_canonical: Any
+) -> bytes:
+    lines: list[str] = []
+    for subject, predicate, value in sorted(
+        rows,
+        key=lambda row: (row[0], row[1], _literal_key(row[2])),
+    ):
+        literal = Literal(value.value, lang=value.language, datatype=value.datatype)
+        lines.append(
+            rdf_canonical.nquads_line(
+                URIRef(subject), URIRef(predicate), literal, ASSERTED_GRAPH
+            )
+        )
+    return ("\n".join(lines) + ("\n" if lines else "")).encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def _parquet_size(rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> int:
+    sink = pa.BufferOutputStream()
+    writer = pq.ParquetWriter(
+        sink,
+        PARQUET_SCHEMA,
+        compression="zstd",
+        compression_level=19,
+        use_dictionary=[],
+        write_statistics=True,
+        version="2.6",
+        data_page_version="2.0",
+    )
+    try:
+        writer.write_table(
+            pa.Table.from_pylist(rows, schema=PARQUET_SCHEMA),
+            row_group_size=50_000,
+        )
+    finally:
+        writer.close()
+    return sink.getvalue().size
+
+
+def _parquet_delta(
+    atlas: audit.AtlasView,
+    additions: set[tuple[str, str, audit.LiteralValue]],
+) -> dict[str, int]:
+    definitions = {
+        subject: sorted(value.value for value in values)
+        for subject, values in atlas.definitions.items()
+    }
+    notes = {
+        subject: sorted({value.value for value in values})
+        for subject, values in atlas.notes.items()
+    }
+    proposed_definitions = {subject: list(values) for subject, values in definitions.items()}
+    proposed_notes = {subject: list(values) for subject, values in notes.items()}
+    conflicts = 0
+    for subject, predicate, value in additions:
+        if predicate == audit.ATLAS_DEFINITION:
+            current = proposed_definitions.setdefault(subject, [])
+            if current and value.value not in current:
+                conflicts += 1
+            elif not current:
+                current.append(value.value)
+        else:
+            current_notes = proposed_notes.setdefault(subject, [])
+            if value.value not in current_notes:
+                current_notes.append(value.value)
+                current_notes.sort()
+
+    resources = sorted(atlas.resources)
+
+    def rows(
+        definition_values: dict[str, list[str]], note_values: dict[str, list[str]]
+    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+        return [
+            {
+                "definition": (
+                    definition_values.get(resource, [None])[0]
+                    if definition_values.get(resource)
+                    else None
+                ),
+                "notes": note_values.get(resource) or None,
+            }
+            for resource in resources
+        ]
+
+    current_size = _parquet_size(rows(definitions, notes))
+    proposed_size = _parquet_size(rows(proposed_definitions, proposed_notes))
+    return {
+        "resourceRowCount": len(resources),
+        "currentDefinitionNotesColumnBytes": current_size,
+        "proposedDefinitionNotesColumnBytes": proposed_size,
+        "incrementalDefinitionNotesColumnBytes": proposed_size - current_size,
+        "definitionConflictCount": conflicts,
+    }
+
+
+def _measure_source(
+    alias: str,
+    spec: audit.SourceSpec,
+    source_root: Path,
+    distribution: Path,
+    units: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    rdf_canonical: Any,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    print(f"measuring {alias}: {spec.name}", flush=True)
+    publisher = audit.read_publisher_inputs(source_root, spec)
+    packs = _pack_paths(spec, units)
+    atlas = audit.read_atlas_source(distribution, packs, _source_claim_subjects(publisher))
+    if atlas.structural_failures:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{spec.name}: Atlas pack read failed: {'; '.join(atlas.structural_failures[:5])}"
+        )
+
+    direct, resource = _publisher_predicate_claims(publisher)
+    claim_counts, omitted_claim_count = _claim_accounting(direct, resource, atlas)
+    expected, eligibility = _expected_english_definition_scope_wire(
+        publisher, direct, resource
+    )
+    current = _current_wire_claims(atlas)
+    additions = expected - current
+    payload = _nquads_payload(additions, rdf_canonical)
+    text_bytes = sum(len(value.value.encode("utf-8")) for _, _, value in additions)
+    compressed = (
+        zstd.compress(
+            payload,
+            options={zstd.CompressionParameter.compression_level: 19},
+        )
+        if payload
+        else b""
+    )
+    parquet = _parquet_delta(atlas, additions)
+
+    publisher_semantic_claim_count = len(publisher.literal_claims) + len(
+        publisher.iri_claims
+    )
+    omission_percentage = (
+        100.0 * omitted_claim_count / publisher_semantic_claim_count
+        if publisher_semantic_claim_count
+        else 0.0
+    )
+    atlas_definition_count = sum(len(values) for values in atlas.definitions.values())
+    atlas_note_count = sum(len(values) for values in atlas.notes.values())
+    return {
+        "alias": alias,
+        "auditorSourceName": spec.name,
+        "auditorReleaseKeys": list(spec.release_keys),
+        "publisherInputPins": [
+            {
+                "path": pin.path,
+                "sha256": pin.sha256,
+                "byteLength": pin.byte_length,
+                "zipMember": pin.zip_member,
+            }
+            for pin in spec.inputs
+        ],
+        "publisherParsedContentDigests": dict(sorted(publisher.input_content_digests.items())),
+        "publisherConceptCount": len(publisher.concepts),
+        "publisherSemanticClaimCount": publisher_semantic_claim_count,
+        "publisherAnnotationClaimsByPredicate": claim_counts,
+        "atlasDefinitionCount": atlas_definition_count,
+        "atlasNoteCount": atlas_note_count,
+        "omittedListedAnnotationClaimCount": omitted_claim_count,
+        "omittedListedAnnotationsPercentOfPublisherSemanticClaims": round(
+            omission_percentage, 6
+        ),
+        "carryEnglishDefinitionAndScopeNote": {
+            **eligibility,
+            "alreadyPresentWireQuadCount": len(expected & current),
+            "incrementalWireQuadCount": len(additions),
+            "incrementalDefinitionQuadCount": sum(
+                predicate == audit.ATLAS_DEFINITION for _, predicate, _ in additions
+            ),
+            "incrementalNoteQuadCount": sum(
+                predicate == audit.ATLAS_NOTE for _, predicate, _ in additions
+            ),
+            "incrementalTextUtf8Bytes": text_bytes,
+            "incrementalCanonicalNQuadsBytes": len(payload),
+            "incrementalCanonicalNQuadsZstd19Bytes": len(compressed),
+            "parquetDefinitionNotesColumnEstimate": parquet,
+        },
+        "atlasPacks": [
+            {
+                "path": path,
+                "sha256": atlas.checked_pack_transports[path][0],
+                "byteLength": atlas.checked_pack_transports[path][1],
+            }
+            for path in packs
+        ],
+    }
+
+
+def _totals(sources: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    publisher_semantic = sum(row["publisherSemanticClaimCount"] for row in sources)
+    omitted = sum(row["omittedListedAnnotationClaimCount"] for row in sources)
+    carry = [row["carryEnglishDefinitionAndScopeNote"] for row in sources]
+    return {
+        "publisherSemanticClaimCount": publisher_semantic,
+        "publisherListedAnnotationClaimCount": sum(
+            detail["publisherClaimCount"]
+            for row in sources
+            for detail in row["publisherAnnotationClaimsByPredicate"].values()
+        ),
+        "atlasDefinitionCount": sum(row["atlasDefinitionCount"] for row in sources),
+        "atlasNoteCount": sum(row["atlasNoteCount"] for row in sources),
+        "omittedListedAnnotationClaimCount": omitted,
+        "omittedListedAnnotationsPercentOfPublisherSemanticClaims": round(
+            100.0 * omitted / publisher_semantic if publisher_semantic else 0.0,
+            6,
+        ),
+        "carryEnglishDefinitionAndScopeNote": {
+            "incrementalWireQuadCount": sum(row["incrementalWireQuadCount"] for row in carry),
+            "incrementalDefinitionQuadCount": sum(
+                row["incrementalDefinitionQuadCount"] for row in carry
+            ),
+            "incrementalNoteQuadCount": sum(row["incrementalNoteQuadCount"] for row in carry),
+            "incrementalTextUtf8Bytes": sum(row["incrementalTextUtf8Bytes"] for row in carry),
+            "incrementalCanonicalNQuadsBytes": sum(
+                row["incrementalCanonicalNQuadsBytes"] for row in carry
+            ),
+            "incrementalCanonicalNQuadsZstd19BytesPerSourceSum": sum(
+                row["incrementalCanonicalNQuadsZstd19Bytes"] for row in carry
+            ),
+            "incrementalParquetDefinitionNotesColumnBytesPerSourceSum": sum(
+                row["parquetDefinitionNotesColumnEstimate"][
+                    "incrementalDefinitionNotesColumnBytes"
+                ]
+                for row in carry
+            ),
+        },
+    }
+

+def main() -> None:
+    args = _parse_args()

+    distribution = args.distribution.resolve()

   141	def registry_resources_from_claim_release(
   142	    view: RegistryClaimReleaseView,
   143	    rules: RegistryClaimResourceRules,
   144	) -> tuple[RegistryResource, ...]:
   145	    """Build normalized resources from exact claims using declarative rules."""
   146	
   147	    claims_by_subject: dict[str, list[RegistryClaim]] = defaultdict(list)
   148	    membership_claims: dict[str, list[RegistryClaim]] = defaultdict(list)
   149	    for claim in view.claims:
   150	        claims_by_subject[claim.subject].append(claim)
   151	        if (
   152	            claim.predicate == rules.member_predicate
   153	            and claim.object_kind == "iri"
   154	            and claim.object_iri == rules.member_object_iri
   155	        ):
   156	            membership_claims[claim.subject].append(claim)
   157	    excluded_subjects = {
   158	        claim.subject
   159	        for claim in view.claims
   160	        if claim.object_kind == "iri"
   161	        and (claim.predicate, cast(str, claim.object_iri))
   162	        in rules.excluded_member_claims
   163	    }
   164	    for subject in excluded_subjects:
   165	        membership_claims.pop(subject, None)
   166	    if not membership_claims:
   167	        raise AtlasRegistryClaimError(
   168	            "claim resource rules selected no release members"
   169	        )
   170	
   171	    resources: list[RegistryResource] = []
   172	    for subject in sorted(membership_claims):
   173	        subject_claims = claims_by_subject[subject]
   174	        source_digests = {
   175	            claim.source_digest for claim in membership_claims[subject]
   176	        }
   177	        if len(source_digests) != 1:
   178	            raise AtlasRegistryClaimError(
   179	                f"claim resource {subject} membership evidence differs"
   180	            )
   181	        notations = tuple(
   182	            sorted(
   183	                {
   184	                    cast(str, claim.lexical_value)
   185	                    for claim in subject_claims
   186	                    if claim.predicate in rules.notation_predicates
   187	                    and claim.object_kind == "literal"
   188	                }
   189	            )
   190	        )
   191	        if rules.notation_predicates and not notations:
   192	            raise AtlasRegistryClaimError(
   193	                f"claim resource {subject} has no selected notation"
   194	            )
   195	        native_payload = {
   196	            **rules.common_native_payload,
   197	            "publisherConceptIri": subject,
   198	            "publisherResourceKind": rules.resource_kind,
   199	        }
   200	        for payload_key, predicate in sorted(rules.native_iri_predicates.items()):
   201	            native_payload[payload_key] = sorted(
   202	                {
   203	                    cast(str, claim.object_iri)
   204	                    for claim in subject_claims
   205	                    if claim.predicate == predicate
   206	                    and claim.object_kind == "iri"
   207	                }
   208	            )
   209	        resources.append(
   210	            RegistryResource(
   211	                iri=subject,
   212	                labels=_compatibility_labels(subject, subject_claims, rules),
   213	                native_payload=native_payload,
   214	                source_locator=subject,
   215	                source_digest=next(iter(source_digests)),
   216	                notations=notations,

   218	            )
   219	        )
   220	    return tuple(resources)

   761	@dataclass(frozen=True)
   762	class DeclaredClaimExclusion:
   763	    """One publisher entity layer a release declares Atlas does not represent.
   764	
   765	    This is a claim-scope declaration, never a waiver. Some publishers ship
   766	    entity kinds beside their terms -- GEMET's Group/Theme/SuperGroup
   767	    collections and its bibliographic Source register, the Publications Office's
   768	    void/lime dataset descriptions -- that Atlas deliberately does not model.
   769	    Leaving those claims in the uncovered report says "we have not looked yet",
   770	    which is false; dropping them silently is worse. An exclusion says instead:
   771	    here is the exact subject set, here is every claim it covers counted by
   772	    predicate, and here is the paired assertion that Atlas asserts *nothing*
   773	    about any of those subjects.
   774	
   775	    That pairing is what keeps it fail-closed. The exclusion only ever removes
   776	    publisher claims from the residue; the Atlas side of the same subjects stays
   777	    in the comparison, so one manufactured claim about an excluded subject fails
   778	    both ``source-claim-coverage`` and ``claim-scope``. An exclusion that
   779	    overlaps a subject the comparison actually compares is itself a failure.
   780	
   781	    Subjects are selected by declared rdf:type or by IRI prefix -- both
   782	    enumerable from the publisher's own bytes, so the receipt can print the set.
   783	    """
   784	
   785	    name: str
   786	    reason: str
   787	    subject_types: frozenset[str] = frozenset()
   788	    subject_iri_prefixes: tuple[str, ...] = ()
   789	
   790	    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
   791	        if not self.subject_types and not self.subject_iri_prefixes:
   792	            raise ValueError(
   793	                f"declared claim exclusion {self.name!r} selects no subjects; an "
   794	                "exclusion must name the exact subject set it covers"
   795	            )
   796	
   797	    def selects(self, subject: str, types: frozenset[str]) -> bool:
   798	        """Return whether one publisher subject falls inside this declaration."""
   799	        if self.subject_types & types:
   800	            return True
   801	        return bool(self.subject_iri_prefixes) and subject.startswith(
   802	            self.subject_iri_prefixes
   803	        )

  6913	def _publisher_subject_types(view: PublisherView) -> dict[str, frozenset[str]]:
  6914	    """Index the rdf:type values the publisher's own bytes assert per subject."""
  6915	    types: dict[str, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
  6916	    for subject, predicate, obj in view.iri_claims:
  6917	        if predicate == RDF_TYPE:
  6918	            types[subject].add(obj)
  6919	    return {subject: frozenset(values) for subject, values in types.items()}

  6922	def _compared_publisher_subjects(pair: SourcePair) -> frozenset[str]:
  6923	    """Return the publisher subjects this adapter's comparisons actually read.
  6924	
  6925	    A declared exclusion that touches one of these would be hiding a compared
  6926	    claim behind a scope declaration, so this is what the overlap guard tests.
  6927	    """
  6928	    endpoints = {
  6929	        *(subject for subject, _, _ in pair.publisher.relations),
  6930	        *(obj for _, _, obj in pair.publisher.relations),
  6931	    }
  6932	    if pair.spec.kind == "mapping":
  6933	        return frozenset(endpoints)
  6934	    return frozenset(
  6935	        {
  6936	            *endpoints,
  6937	            *pair.publisher.concepts,
  6938	            *_publisher_source_scheme_subjects(pair.publisher),
  6939	            *pair.publisher.resource_annotation_target_claim_counts,
  6940	        }
  6941	    )

  6943	
  6944	def _declared_exclusion_subjects(
  6945	    pair: SourcePair,
  6946	) -> tuple[tuple[DeclaredClaimExclusion, frozenset[str]], ...]:
  6947	    """Resolve each declared exclusion to the exact publisher subjects it selects."""
  6948	    exclusions = pair.spec.declared_claim_exclusions
  6949	    if not exclusions:
  6950	        return ()
  6951	    types = _publisher_subject_types(pair.publisher)
  6952	    subjects = {
  6953	        *(subject for subject, _, _ in pair.publisher.iri_claims),
  6954	        *(subject for subject, _, _ in pair.publisher.literal_claims),
  6955	    }
  6956	    resolved: list[tuple[DeclaredClaimExclusion, frozenset[str]]] = []
  6957	    for exclusion in exclusions:
  6958	        empty: frozenset[str] = frozenset()
  6959	        resolved.append(
  6960	            (
  6961	                exclusion,
  6962	                frozenset(
  6963	                    subject
  6964	                    for subject in subjects
  6965	                    if exclusion.selects(subject, types.get(subject, empty))
  6966	                ),
  6967	            )
  6968	        )
  6969	    return tuple(resolved)

  6972	def _declared_excluded_publisher_claims(
  6973	    pair: SourcePair,
  6974	) -> tuple[
  6975	    frozenset[tuple[str, str, str]],
  6976	    frozenset[tuple[str, str, LiteralValue]],
  6977	]:
  6978	    """Return the publisher claims every declared exclusion accounts for.
  6979	
  6980	    Subjects the comparison actually compares are never excluded, whatever a
  6981	    declaration says: the overlap is reported as a failure by ``claim-scope``
  6982	    instead of quietly shrinking the residue.
  6983	    """
  6984	    resolved = _declared_exclusion_subjects(pair)
  6985	    if not resolved:
  6986	        return frozenset(), frozenset()
  6987	    compared = _compared_publisher_subjects(pair)
  6988	    selected = frozenset().union(*(subjects for _, subjects in resolved)) - compared
  6989	    return (
  6990	        frozenset(row for row in pair.publisher.iri_claims if row[0] in selected),
  6991	        frozenset(row for row in pair.publisher.literal_claims if row[0] in selected),
  6992	    )

  6995	def _declared_claim_exclusion_report(pair: SourcePair) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
  6996	    """Report each declared exclusion, what it covers, and whether it still holds."""
  6997	    resolved = _declared_exclusion_subjects(pair)
  6998	    if not resolved:
  6999	        return []
  7000	    compared = _compared_publisher_subjects(pair)
  7001	    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
  7002	    for exclusion, subjects in resolved:
  7003	        overlap = sorted(subjects & compared)
  7004	        selected = subjects - compared
  7005	        counts: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
  7006	        for subject, predicate, _ in pair.publisher.iri_claims:
  7007	            if subject in selected:
  7008	                counts[predicate] += 1
  7009	        for subject, predicate, _ in pair.publisher.literal_claims:
  7010	            if subject in selected:
  7011	                counts[predicate] += 1
  7012	        atlas_iri = sorted(
  7013	            row for row in pair.atlas.all_raw_iri_claims if row[0] in selected
  7014	        )
  7015	        atlas_literals = sorted(
  7016	            (row for row in pair.atlas.all_raw_literal_claims if row[0] in selected),
  7017	            key=_literal_claim_sort_key,
  7018	        )
  7019	        atlas_claims = [
  7020	            *(list(row) for row in atlas_iri[:5]),
  7021	            *(
  7022	                [subject, predicate, _literal_repr(literal)]
  7023	                for subject, predicate, literal in atlas_literals[:5]
  7024	            ),
  7025	        ]
  7026	        blank_node_claims = pair.publisher.declared_out_of_scope_blank_node_claims.get(
  7027	            exclusion.name, ()
  7028	        )
  7029	        holds = not atlas_iri and not atlas_literals and not overlap
  7030	        rows.append(
  7031	            {
  7032	                "name": exclusion.name,
  7033	                "reason": exclusion.reason,
  7034	                "subjectTypes": sorted(exclusion.subject_types),
  7035	                "subjectIriPrefixes": list(exclusion.subject_iri_prefixes),
  7036	                "subjectCount": len(selected),
  7037	                "publisherClaimCount": sum(counts.values()),
  7038	                "publisherClaimCountsByPredicate": dict(sorted(counts.items())),
  7039	                "publisherBlankNodeClaimCount": len(blank_node_claims),
  7040	                "publisherBlankNodeClaimExamples": list(blank_node_claims[:5]),
  7041	                "atlasClaimCount": len(atlas_iri) + len(atlas_literals),
  7042	                "atlasClaimExamples": atlas_claims,
  7043	                "comparedSubjectOverlapCount": len(overlap),
  7044	                "comparedSubjectOverlapExamples": overlap[:5],
  7045	                "status": "declared-out-of-scope" if holds else "violated",
  7046	                "meaning": (
  7047	                    "publisher claims this release declares Atlas does not "
  7048	                    "represent; the declaration holds only while Atlas asserts "
  7049	                    "nothing about these subjects and never covers a subject the "
  7050	                    "comparison reads"
  7051	                ),
  7052	            }
  7053	        )
  7054	    return rows

  8569	def _cached_comparison_claim_scope(
  8570	    ctx: Context,
  8571	    spec: SourceSpec,
  8572	    pair: SourcePair | None,
  8573	) -> dict[str, Any]:
  8574	    """Compute one immutable-input claim scope once and reuse it in the receipt."""
  8575	    cached = ctx.comparison_claim_scope_cache.get(spec)
  8576	    if cached is not None:
  8577	        return cached
  8578	    scope = _comparison_claim_scope(spec, pair)
  8579	    ctx.comparison_claim_scope_cache[spec] = scope
  8580	    return scope

  8583	def _evaluate_claim_scope(ctx: Context) -> CheckResult:
  8584	    """Fail closed on unhandled publisher predicates or known lossy representations."""
  8585	    failures = _incomplete_evaluation_failure(ctx, "claim-scope review")
  8586	    for kind in ("native-control", "source-extract"):
  8587	        failures.extend(
  8588	            _incomplete_evaluation_failure(ctx, "claim-scope review", kind)
  8589	        )
  8590	    checked = 0
  8591	    for pair in ctx.pairs:
  8592	        scope = _cached_comparison_claim_scope(ctx, pair.spec, pair)
  8593	        checked += len(scope["claimFamilies"])
  8594	        for row in scope["unexpectedPublisherPredicates"]:
  8595	            failures.append(
  8596	                f"{pair.spec.name}: publisher predicate <{row['predicate']}> has "
  8597	                f"{row['claimCount']} resource claims but no comparison or explicit exclusion"
  8598	            )
  8599	        for family in scope["intentionallyExcludedFamilies"]:
  8600	            if family.get("status", "declared-out-of-scope") == "declared-out-of-scope":
  8601	                continue
  8602	            if family["atlasClaimCount"]:
  8603	                failures.append(
  8604	                    f"{pair.spec.name}: declared exclusion {family['name']} does not "
  8605	                    f"hold -- Atlas asserts {family['atlasClaimCount']} claim(s) about "
  8606	                    f"subjects it declares out of scope; examples "
  8607	                    f"{family['atlasClaimExamples'][:5]}"
  8608	                )
  8609	            if family["comparedSubjectOverlapCount"]:
  8610	                failures.append(
  8611	                    f"{pair.spec.name}: declared exclusion {family['name']} covers "
  8612	                    f"{family['comparedSubjectOverlapCount']} subject(s) this "
  8613	                    "comparison also compares; a scope declaration may never hide a "
  8614	                    f"compared claim; examples {family['comparedSubjectOverlapExamples']}"
  8615	                )
  8616	        for family in scope["claimFamilies"]:
  8617	            if family["status"] == "normalized-lossy":
  8618	                failures.append(
  8619	                    f"{pair.spec.name}: {family['name']} is represented with known semantic loss"
  8620	                )
  8621	            elif family["status"] not in {"exact", "not-applicable"}:
  8622	                failures.append(
  8623	                    f"{pair.spec.name}: {family['name']} source claims are "
  8624	                    f"{family['status']}"
  8625	                )
  8626	    native_fidelity = check_native_control_fidelity(ctx)
  8627	    for pair in ctx.native_control_pairs:
  8628	        prefix = f"{pair.spec.name}:"
  8629	        pair_failures = [
  8630	            failure for failure in native_fidelity.failures if failure.startswith(prefix)
  8631	        ]
  8632	        scope = _native_control_claim_scope(pair.spec, pair, pair_failures)
  8633	        checked += len(scope["claimFamilies"])
  8634	        for family in scope["claimFamilies"]:
  8635	            if family["status"] in {"differences-found", "unrepresented"}:
    65	# Low-cardinality string columns are dictionary-encoded on disk by the writer's

   238	
   239	def _transform(role: CompactRecordRole, row: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
   240	    if role is CompactRecordRole.RESOURCE:
   241	        return {key: value for key, value in row.items() if key != "content_digest"}
   242	    if role is CompactRecordRole.LABEL:
   243	        if not row.get("id"):
   244	            raise AtlasParquetSearchViewError(_MISSING_LABEL_ID)
   245	        return {key: value for key, value in row.items() if key != "content_digest"}
   246	    if role is CompactRecordRole.STATEMENT:
   247	        if _suffix(row["id"], "assertion") != row["assertion_identity_digest"]:
   248	            raise AtlasParquetSearchViewError("statement identifier differs from assertionIdentityDigest")
   249	        return {key: value for key, value in row.items() if key not in {"assertion_identity_digest", "content_digest"}}
   250	    if role is CompactRecordRole.EVIDENCE_BINDING:
   275	        return {key: value for key, value in row.items() if key != "content_digest"}
   276	    if role is CompactRecordRole.LIFECYCLE_EVENT:
   277	        return {key: value for key, value in row.items() if key != "content_digest"}
   278	    raise AssertionError(role)
   279	
   280	
   281	def _write_role(source: Path, target: Path, role: CompactRecordRole) -> int:
   282	    parquet = pq.ParquetFile(source)
   283	    schema = _SCHEMAS[role]
   284	    writer = pq.ParquetWriter(
   285	        target,
   286	        schema,
   287	        compression="zstd",
   288	        compression_level=COMPRESSION_LEVEL,
   289	        use_dictionary=_DICTIONARIES[role],
   290	        write_statistics=True,
   291	        version="2.6",
   292	        data_page_version="2.0",
   293	    )
   294	    count = 0
   295	    try:
   296	        for batch in parquet.iter_batches(batch_size=ROW_GROUP_SIZE):
   297	            rows = [_transform(role, row) for row in batch.to_pylist()]
   298	            writer.write_table(pa.Table.from_pylist(rows, schema=schema), row_group_size=ROW_GROUP_SIZE)
   299	            count += len(rows)
   300	        if count == 0:
   301	            writer.write_table(schema.empty_table())
   302	    finally:
   303	        writer.close()
   304	    return count

    91	The retired exhaustive compact-to-RDF parity implementation remains available
    92	through the [dated archive note](../research/archive/atlas-3.0-exhaustive-compact-parity-2026-08-08.md).
    93	The active release validator recomputes every release's logical record counts
    94	from the asserted graph; the builder proves full record-identity equality
    95	between the served tables and the graph, both directions, and compares a
    96	bounded deterministic sample of whole rows against the RDF.
    97	
    98	## Compact search profile
    99	
   100	The separately named compact search view retains compressible native text
   101	references and removes reconstructable row-integrity fields. It retains labels,
   102	graph facts, source digests and locators, review decisions, and methods needed
   103	for search explanations. It omits source-native payload bodies and redundant
   104	digests or identifiers whose values are either reconstructed from a retained
   105	identifier or used only to authenticate the pinned full view. Those omitted
   106	values remain in the pinned full view and canonical RDF.
   107	
   108	Search view 1.1 carries the canonical `Label.id` in the Label table's `id`
   109	column, copied from the pinned full view (REF-025). The manifest states
   110	`schemaVersion: 1.1`, `Label.id` is absent from `status.omittedFields`, and
   111	verification refuses a Label member without that column and refuses a manifest
   112	naming another schema version.

+The program reads the exact eight bulk-SKOS scopes declared by the independent
+source-fidelity auditor, then compares their pinned publisher claims with one
+named Atlas distribution. It writes measurements only; it does not modify the
+publisher inputs or the Atlas artifact.

+def _parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:

+    parser.add_argument("--source-root", type=Path, required=True)

+def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _load_rdf_canonical() -> Any:
+    path = Path("bindings/atlas/3.1/tools/rdf_canonical.py").resolve()
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("fidelity_rdf_canonical", path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"cannot import canonical RDF renderer from {path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module

+def _construction_units(distribution: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], str]:
+    path = distribution / audit.CONSTRUCTION_SUMMARY
+    payload = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
+    releases = payload.get("releases")
+    if not isinstance(releases, list):
+        raise ValueError(f"{path}: releases must be an array")
+    units: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    for release in releases:
+        if not isinstance(release, dict) or not isinstance(release.get("key"), str):
+            raise ValueError(f"{path}: malformed release row")
+        units[release["key"]] = release
+    return units, _sha256(path)

+def _pack_paths(spec: audit.SourceSpec, units: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    paths: list[str] = []
+    for key in spec.release_keys:
+        unit = units.get(key)
+        if unit is None:
+            raise ValueError(f"distribution omits construction unit {key!r}")
+        packs = unit.get("rdfPacks")
+        if not isinstance(packs, list):
+            raise ValueError(f"construction unit {key!r} has malformed rdfPacks")
+        for pack in packs:
+            if not isinstance(pack, dict) or not isinstance(pack.get("path"), str):
+                raise ValueError(f"construction unit {key!r} has malformed pack row")
+            paths.append(pack["path"].removeprefix("packs/"))
+    return tuple(paths)

+def _source_claim_subjects(view: audit.PublisherView) -> frozenset[str]:
+    schemes = {
+        *view.schemes,
+        *(scheme for _, scheme in view.memberships),
+        *(scheme for _, scheme in view.top_concept_of),
+        *(scheme for scheme, _ in view.has_top_concept),
+    }
+    return frozenset(
+        {
+            *view.concepts,
+            *schemes,
+            *view.resource_annotation_target_claim_counts,
+            *(subject for subject, _, _ in view.relations),
+            *(obj for _, _, obj in view.relations),
+        }
+    )

+def _literal_key(value: audit.LiteralValue) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
+    return (value.value, value.language or "", value.datatype or "")

+def _publisher_predicate_claims(
+    view: audit.PublisherView,
+) -> tuple[
+    dict[str, set[tuple[str, audit.LiteralValue]]],
+    dict[str, set[tuple[str, str]]],
+]:
+    direct: dict[str, set[tuple[str, audit.LiteralValue]]] = {
+        name: set() for name in PREDICATES
+    }
+    resource: dict[str, set[tuple[str, str]]] = {name: set() for name in PREDICATES}
+    names_by_iri = {iri: name for name, iri in PREDICATES.items()}
+    for subject, predicate, value in view.literal_claims:
+        name = names_by_iri.get(predicate)
+        if name is not None:
+            direct[name].add((subject, value))
+    for subject, predicate, target in view.iri_claims:
+        name = names_by_iri.get(predicate)
+        if name is not None:
+            resource[name].add((subject, target))
+    return direct, resource

+def _atlas_values(

+def _claim_accounting(
+    direct: dict[str, set[tuple[str, audit.LiteralValue]]],
+    resource: dict[str, set[tuple[str, str]]],
+    atlas: audit.AtlasView,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, int]], int]:
+    rows: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
+    omitted_total = 0
+    for name in PREDICATES:
+        target = _atlas_values(atlas, WIRE_PREDICATE[name])
+        carried = sum(value in target.get(subject, ()) for subject, value in direct[name])
+        literal_count = len(direct[name])
+        iri_count = len(resource[name])
+        publisher_count = literal_count + iri_count
+        omitted = publisher_count - carried
+        rows[name] = {
+            "publisherClaimCount": publisher_count,
+            "publisherLiteralClaimCount": literal_count,
+            "publisherIriClaimCount": iri_count,
+            "atlasExactLiteralCarryCount": carried,
+            "omittedClaimCount": omitted,
+        }
+        omitted_total += omitted
+    return rows, omitted_total

+def _english(value: audit.LiteralValue) -> bool:
+    return value.language is not None and value.language.casefold() == "en"
+

+def _resolved_english_values(
+    view: audit.PublisherView,
+    target: str,
+) -> frozenset[audit.LiteralValue]:
+    return frozenset(
+        value
+        for subject, predicate, value in view.literal_claims
+        if subject == target and predicate == RDF_VALUE and _english(value)
+    )

+
+def _expected_english_definition_scope_wire(
+    view: audit.PublisherView,
+    direct: dict[str, set[tuple[str, audit.LiteralValue]]],
+    resource: dict[str, set[tuple[str, str]]],
+) -> tuple[
+    set[tuple[str, str, audit.LiteralValue]],
+    dict[str, int],
+]:
+    definitions: dict[str, set[audit.LiteralValue]] = defaultdict(set)
+    scope_notes: dict[str, set[audit.LiteralValue]] = defaultdict(set)
+    direct_claims = 0
+    direct_claims_by_predicate = {
+        "skos:definition": 0,
+        "skos:scopeNote": 0,
+    }
+    iri_claims = 0
+    resolved_iri_claims = 0
+    empty_english_text_claims = 0
+
+    for subject, value in direct["skos:definition"]:
+        if _english(value):
+            if not value.value:
+                empty_english_text_claims += 1
+                continue
+            definitions[subject].add(value)
+            direct_claims += 1
+            direct_claims_by_predicate["skos:definition"] += 1
+    for subject, value in direct["skos:scopeNote"]:
+        if _english(value):
+            if not value.value:
+                empty_english_text_claims += 1
+                continue
+            scope_notes[subject].add(value)
+            direct_claims += 1
+            direct_claims_by_predicate["skos:scopeNote"] += 1
+
+    for name, target_rows in (
+        ("skos:definition", definitions),
+        ("skos:scopeNote", scope_notes),
+    ):
+        for subject, target in resource[name]:
+            iri_claims += 1
+            values = frozenset(
+                value for value in _resolved_english_values(view, target) if value.value
+            )
+            if values:
+                resolved_iri_claims += 1
+                target_rows[subject].update(values)
+
+    expected: set[tuple[str, str, audit.LiteralValue]] = set()
+    multi_definition_subject_count = 0
+    for subject, values in definitions.items():
+        ordered = sorted(values, key=_literal_key)
+        if len(ordered) > 1:
+            multi_definition_subject_count += 1
+        expected.add((subject, audit.ATLAS_DEFINITION, ordered[0]))
+        expected.update((subject, audit.ATLAS_NOTE, value) for value in ordered[1:])
+    for subject, values in scope_notes.items():
+        expected.update((subject, audit.ATLAS_NOTE, value) for value in values)
+
+    return expected, {
+        "eligibleDirectLiteralClaimCount": direct_claims,
+        "eligibleDirectLiteralClaimsByPredicate": direct_claims_by_predicate,
+        "eligibleIriClaimCount": iri_claims,
+        "resolvedIriClaimCount": resolved_iri_claims,
+        "unresolvedIriClaimCount": iri_claims - resolved_iri_claims,
+        "emptyEnglishTextClaimCount": empty_english_text_claims,
+        "multiDefinitionSubjectCount": multi_definition_subject_count,
+    }
+
+
+def _current_wire_claims(atlas: audit.AtlasView) -> set[tuple[str, str, audit.LiteralValue]]:
+    rows = {
+        (subject, audit.ATLAS_DEFINITION, value)
+        for subject, values in atlas.definitions.items()
+        for value in values
+    }
+    rows.update(
+        (subject, audit.ATLAS_NOTE, value)
+        for subject, values in atlas.notes.items()
+        for value in values
+    )
+    return rows

+def _nquads_payload(
+    rows: set[tuple[str, str, audit.LiteralValue]], rdf_canonical: Any
+) -> bytes:
+    lines: list[str] = []
+    for subject, predicate, value in sorted(
+        rows,
+        key=lambda row: (row[0], row[1], _literal_key(row[2])),
+    ):
+        literal = Literal(value.value, lang=value.language, datatype=value.datatype)
+        lines.append(
+            rdf_canonical.nquads_line(
+                URIRef(subject), URIRef(predicate), literal, ASSERTED_GRAPH
+            )
+        )
+    return ("\n".join(lines) + ("\n" if lines else "")).encode("utf-8")
+

+def _parquet_size(rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> int:
+    sink = pa.BufferOutputStream()
+    writer = pq.ParquetWriter(
+        sink,
+        PARQUET_SCHEMA,
+        compression="zstd",
+        compression_level=19,
+        use_dictionary=[],
+        write_statistics=True,
+        version="2.6",
+        data_page_version="2.0",
+    )
+    try:
+        writer.write_table(
+            pa.Table.from_pylist(rows, schema=PARQUET_SCHEMA),
+            row_group_size=50_000,
+        )
+    finally:
+        writer.close()
+    return sink.getvalue().size
+
+
+def _parquet_delta(
+    atlas: audit.AtlasView,
+    additions: set[tuple[str, str, audit.LiteralValue]],
+) -> dict[str, int]:
+    definitions = {
+        subject: sorted(value.value for value in values)
+        for subject, values in atlas.definitions.items()
+    }
+    notes = {
+        subject: sorted({value.value for value in values})
+        for subject, values in atlas.notes.items()
+    }
+    proposed_definitions = {subject: list(values) for subject, values in definitions.items()}
+    proposed_notes = {subject: list(values) for subject, values in notes.items()}
+    conflicts = 0
+    for subject, predicate, value in additions:
+        if predicate == audit.ATLAS_DEFINITION:
+            current = proposed_definitions.setdefault(subject, [])
+            if current and value.value not in current:
+                conflicts += 1
+            elif not current:
+                current.append(value.value)
+        else:
+            current_notes = proposed_notes.setdefault(subject, [])
+            if value.value not in current_notes:
+                current_notes.append(value.value)
+                current_notes.sort()
+
+    resources = sorted(atlas.resources)
+
+    def rows(
+        definition_values: dict[str, list[str]], note_values: dict[str, list[str]]
+    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+        return [
+            {
+                "definition": (
+                    definition_values.get(resource, [None])[0]
+                    if definition_values.get(resource)
+                    else None
+                ),
+                "notes": note_values.get(resource) or None,
+            }
+            for resource in resources
+        ]
+
+    current_size = _parquet_size(rows(definitions, notes))
+    proposed_size = _parquet_size(rows(proposed_definitions, proposed_notes))
+    return {
+        "resourceRowCount": len(resources),
+        "currentDefinitionNotesColumnBytes": current_size,
+        "proposedDefinitionNotesColumnBytes": proposed_size,
+        "incrementalDefinitionNotesColumnBytes": proposed_size - current_size,
+        "definitionConflictCount": conflicts,
+    }
+
+
+def _measure_source(
+    alias: str,
+    spec: audit.SourceSpec,
+    source_root: Path,
+    distribution: Path,
+    units: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    rdf_canonical: Any,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    print(f"measuring {alias}: {spec.name}", flush=True)
+    publisher = audit.read_publisher_inputs(source_root, spec)
+    packs = _pack_paths(spec, units)
+    atlas = audit.read_atlas_source(distribution, packs, _source_claim_subjects(publisher))
+    if atlas.structural_failures:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{spec.name}: Atlas pack read failed: {'; '.join(atlas.structural_failures[:5])}"
+        )
+
+    direct, resource = _publisher_predicate_claims(publisher)
+    claim_counts, omitted_claim_count = _claim_accounting(direct, resource, atlas)
+    expected, eligibility = _expected_english_definition_scope_wire(
+        publisher, direct, resource
+    )
+    current = _current_wire_claims(atlas)
+    additions = expected - current
+    payload = _nquads_payload(additions, rdf_canonical)
+    text_bytes = sum(len(value.value.encode("utf-8")) for _, _, value in additions)
+    compressed = (
+        zstd.compress(
+            payload,
+            options={zstd.CompressionParameter.compression_level: 19},
+        )
+        if payload
+        else b""
+    )
+    parquet = _parquet_delta(atlas, additions)
+
+    publisher_semantic_claim_count = len(publisher.literal_claims) + len(
+        publisher.iri_claims
+    )
+    omission_percentage = (
+        100.0 * omitted_claim_count / publisher_semantic_claim_count
+        if publisher_semantic_claim_count
+        else 0.0
+    )
+    atlas_definition_count = sum(len(values) for values in atlas.definitions.values())
+    atlas_note_count = sum(len(values) for values in atlas.notes.values())
+    return {
+        "alias": alias,
+        "auditorSourceName": spec.name,
+        "auditorReleaseKeys": list(spec.release_keys),
+        "publisherInputPins": [
+            {
+                "path": pin.path,
+                "sha256": pin.sha256,
+                "byteLength": pin.byte_length,
+                "zipMember": pin.zip_member,
+            }
+            for pin in spec.inputs
+        ],
+        "publisherParsedContentDigests": dict(sorted(publisher.input_content_digests.items())),
+        "publisherConceptCount": len(publisher.concepts),
+        "publisherSemanticClaimCount": publisher_semantic_claim_count,
+        "publisherAnnotationClaimsByPredicate": claim_counts,
+        "atlasDefinitionCount": atlas_definition_count,
+        "atlasNoteCount": atlas_note_count,
+        "omittedListedAnnotationClaimCount": omitted_claim_count,
+        "omittedListedAnnotationsPercentOfPublisherSemanticClaims": round(
+            omission_percentage, 6
+        ),
+        "carryEnglishDefinitionAndScopeNote": {
+            **eligibility,
+            "alreadyPresentWireQuadCount": len(expected & current),
+            "incrementalWireQuadCount": len(additions),
+            "incrementalDefinitionQuadCount": sum(
+                predicate == audit.ATLAS_DEFINITION for _, predicate, _ in additions
+            ),
+            "incrementalNoteQuadCount": sum(
+                predicate == audit.ATLAS_NOTE for _, predicate, _ in additions
+            ),
+            "incrementalTextUtf8Bytes": text_bytes,
+            "incrementalCanonicalNQuadsBytes": len(payload),
+            "incrementalCanonicalNQuadsZstd19Bytes": len(compressed),
+            "parquetDefinitionNotesColumnEstimate": parquet,
+        },
+        "atlasPacks": [
+            {
+                "path": path,
+                "sha256": atlas.checked_pack_transports[path][0],
+                "byteLength": atlas.checked_pack_transports[path][1],
+            }
+            for path in packs
+        ],
+    }
+
+
+def _totals(sources: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    publisher_semantic = sum(row["publisherSemanticClaimCount"] for row in sources)
+    omitted = sum(row["omittedListedAnnotationClaimCount"] for row in sources)
+    carry = [row["carryEnglishDefinitionAndScopeNote"] for row in sources]
+    return {
+        "publisherSemanticClaimCount": publisher_semantic,
+        "publisherListedAnnotationClaimCount": sum(
+            detail["publisherClaimCount"]
+            for row in sources
+            for detail in row["publisherAnnotationClaimsByPredicate"].values()
+        ),
+        "atlasDefinitionCount": sum(row["atlasDefinitionCount"] for row in sources),
+        "atlasNoteCount": sum(row["atlasNoteCount"] for row in sources),
+        "omittedListedAnnotationClaimCount": omitted,
+        "omittedListedAnnotationsPercentOfPublisherSemanticClaims": round(
+            100.0 * omitted / publisher_semantic if publisher_semantic else 0.0,
+            6,
+        ),
+        "carryEnglishDefinitionAndScopeNote": {
+            "incrementalWireQuadCount": sum(row["incrementalWireQuadCount"] for row in carry),
+            "incrementalDefinitionQuadCount": sum(
+                row["incrementalDefinitionQuadCount"] for row in carry
+            ),
+            "incrementalNoteQuadCount": sum(row["incrementalNoteQuadCount"] for row in carry),
+            "incrementalTextUtf8Bytes": sum(row["incrementalTextUtf8Bytes"] for row in carry),
+            "incrementalCanonicalNQuadsBytes": sum(
+                row["incrementalCanonicalNQuadsBytes"] for row in carry
+            ),
+            "incrementalCanonicalNQuadsZstd19BytesPerSourceSum": sum(
+                row["incrementalCanonicalNQuadsZstd19Bytes"] for row in carry
+            ),
+            "incrementalParquetDefinitionNotesColumnBytesPerSourceSum": sum(
+                row["parquetDefinitionNotesColumnEstimate"][
+                    "incrementalDefinitionNotesColumnBytes"
+                ]
+                for row in carry
+            ),
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    args = _parse_args()
+    source_root = args.source_root.resolve()
+    distribution = args.distribution.resolve()
+    output = args.output.resolve()
+    units, summary_digest = _construction_units(distribution)
+    rdf_canonical = _load_rdf_canonical()
+    specs = {spec.name: spec for spec in audit.SOURCES if spec.kind == "vocabulary"}
+
+    expected_names = set(SOURCE_ALIASES.values())
+    missing = expected_names - specs.keys()
+    if missing:
+        raise ValueError(f"auditor SOURCES omits expected bulk-SKOS scopes: {sorted(missing)}")
+
+    source_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for alias, source_name in SOURCE_ALIASES.items():
+        source_rows.append(
+            _measure_source(
+                alias,
+                specs[source_name],
+                source_root,
+                distribution,
+                units,
+                rdf_canonical,
+            )
+        )
+        gc.collect()
+
+    peak_rss = process_resource.getrusage(process_resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss
+    peak_rss_bytes = peak_rss if platform.system() == "Darwin" else peak_rss * 1024
+    payload = {
+        "measurementVersion": MEASUREMENT_VERSION,
+        "measurementScript": Path(__file__).name,
+        "measurementScriptSha256": _sha256(Path(__file__)),
+        "auditorVersion": audit.VERIFIER_VERSION,
+        "sourceRoot": str(source_root),
+        "distribution": str(distribution),
+        "constructionSummarySha256": summary_digest,
+        "execution": {
+            "peakRssBytesObserved": peak_rss_bytes,
+            "peakRssLimitBytes": 6 * 1024**3,
+            "withinPeakRssLimit": peak_rss_bytes < 6 * 1024**3,
+        },
+        "method": {
+            "sourceScope": (
+                "The exact selected PublisherView for each named vocabulary SourceSpec in "
+                "tools/verify_atlas_source_fidelity.py."
+            ),
+            "publisherSemanticClaimDenominator": (
+                "Unique IRI-subject literal and IRI-object RDF claims retained in the "
+                "auditor's selected publisher view; blank-node claims are outside this denominator."
+            ),
+            "publisherAnnotationNumerator": (
+                "Unique claims using skos:definition, skos:scopeNote, skos:note, "
+                "skos:example, skos:historyNote, skos:editorialNote, or rdfs:comment."
+            ),
+            "atlasCarry": (
+                "An exact subject-and-literal match in atlas:definition or atlas:note. "
+                "An IRI-valued publisher annotation is not counted as carried by those literal fields."
+            ),
+            "carryEstimate": (
+                "English-tagged skos:definition and skos:scopeNote values only. IRI-valued "
+                "annotations are resolved through English rdf:value. One sorted definition per "
+                "subject maps to atlas:definition; additional definitions and scope notes map to atlas:note."
+            ),
+            "wireBytes": (
+                "Exact canonical N-Quads rendering under the Atlas 3.1 asserted graph, plus "
+                "Zstandard level-19 compression of each source's incremental lines in isolation."
+            ),
+            "parquetBytes": (
+                "Difference between current and proposed definition/notes-only Parquet tables, "
+                "using the search view's schema types, 50,000-row groups, Zstandard level 19, "
+                "data page v2, and no dictionary encoding for these two columns. Per-file footer "
+                "overhead makes this an estimate, not an expected whole-artifact byte delta."
+            ),
+        },
+        "sources": source_rows,
+        "totals": _totals(source_rows),
+    }
+    output.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    print(f"peak RSS: {peak_rss_bytes} bytes", flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

  1120	a test on the payload proves that before each contribution.
